name: Apex Reference Guide
description:
Apex is a strongly typed, object-oriented programming language that allows developers
        to execute flow and transaction control statements on the Salesforce Platform server, in
        conjunction with calls to the API. This reference guide includes built-in Apex classes,
        interfaces, enums, and exceptions, grouped by namespace. It also includes Apex DML
        statements to insert, update, merge, delete, and restore data in Salesforce.

name: Apex Release Notes
description:
Use the Salesforce Release Notes to learn about the most recent updates and changes to
  Apex.

name: Apex DML Operations
description:
You can perform DML operations using the Apex DML statements or the methods of the
            Database class. For lead conversion, use the
            convertLead method of the Database class. There is no DML counterpart for
        it.

name: ApexPages Namespace
description:
The ApexPages namespace
provides classes used in Visualforce controllers.

name: Action
description:
You can use ApexPages.Action to create an
        action method that you can use in a Visualforce custom controller or controller
        extension.

methods.name: Action
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the ApexPages.Action class using the specified action.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description:
Returns the expression that is evaluated when the action
is invoked.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes the action.

name: Component
description:
Represents a dynamic Visualforce component in
  Apex.

properties.name: childComponents
properties.description: Returns a reference to the child components for the component.

properties.name: expressions
properties.description:
Sets the content of an attribute using the expression language
notation. The notation for this is expressions.name_of_attribute.

properties.name: facets
properties.description: Sets the content of a facet to a dynamic component. The notation is facet.name_of_facet.

name: IdeaStandardController
description:
IdeaStandardController objects offer Ideas-specific functionality in addition to what is
provided by the StandardController.

methods.name: getCommentList
methods.description:
Returns the list of read-only comments from the current
page.

name: IdeaStandardSetController
description:
IdeaStandardSetController objects offer Ideas-specific functionality in addition to what is
provided by the StandardSetController.

methods.name: getIdeaList
methods.description:
Returns the list of read-only ideas in the current page
set.

name: KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController
description:
KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController
        objects offer article-specific functionality in addition to what is provided by the StandardController.

methods.name: KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController class
using the specified knowledge article.

methods.name: getSourceId
methods.description:
Returns the ID for the source object record when creating
a new article from another object.

methods.name: setDataCategory
methods.signature:
public Void setDataCategory(String categoryGroup,
String category)
methods.description:
Specifies a default data category for the specified data
category group when creating a new article.

name: Message
description:
Contains validation errors that occur when the user saves the page that uses a standard
  controller.

methods.name: Message
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the ApexPages.Message class using the specified message severity
and summary.

methods.name: Message
methods.signature:
public Message(ApexPages.Severity severity,
String summary, String detail)
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the ApexPages.Message class using the specified message severity,
summary, and message detail.

methods.name: Message
methods.signature:
public Message(ApexPages.Severity severity,
String summary, String detail, String id)
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the ApexPages.Message class using the specified severity, summary,
detail, and component ID.

methods.name: getComponentLabel
methods.description:
Returns the label of the associated inputField component. If no label
is defined, this method returns null.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description:
Returns the value of the detail parameter used to create
the message. If no detail String was specified, this method returns null.

methods.name: getSeverity
methods.description: Returns the severity enum used to create the message.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Returns the summary String used to create the message.

name: StandardController
description:
Use a StandardController when defining an extension for
a standard controller.

methods.name: StandardController
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the ApexPages.StandardController class for the specified standard
or custom object.

methods.name: addFields
methods.description:
When a Visualforce page is
  loaded, the fields accessible to the page are based on the fields referenced in the Visualforce markup. This method adds a
  reference to each field specified in fieldNames so that
  the controller can explicitly access those fields as well.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Returns the PageReference of the cancel page.

methods.name: delete
methods.description:
Deletes record and returns the PageReference of the delete
page.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Returns the PageReference of the standard edit page.

methods.name: getId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the record that is currently in context,
based on the value of the id query string parameter in the Visualforce page URL.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description:
Returns the record that is currently in context, based
on the value of the id query
string parameter in the Visualforce page URL.

methods.name: reset
methods.description:
Forces the controller to reacquire access to newly referenced
fields. Any changes made to the record prior to this method call are
discarded.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves changes and returns the updated PageReference.

methods.name: view
methods.description:
Returns the PageReference object of the standard detail
page.

name: StandardSetController
description:
StandardSetController objects allow you to
  create list controllers similar to, or as extensions of, the pre-built Visualforce list
  controllers provided by Salesforce.

methods.name: StandardSetController
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the ApexPages.StandardSetController class for the list of objects returned by the query
  locator.

methods.name: StandardSetController
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the ApexPages.StandardSetController class for the specified list of standard or custom
  objects.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description:
Returns the PageReference of the original page, if known,
or the home page.

methods.name: first
methods.description:
Changes the set of records that the controller returns to the first
  page of records.

methods.name: getCompleteResult
methods.description:
Indicates whether there are more records in the set than
the maximum record limit. If this is false, there are more records
than you can process using the list controller. The maximum record
limit is 10,000 records.

methods.name: getFilterId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the filter that is currently in context.

methods.name: getHasNext
methods.description:
Indicates whether there are more records after the current
page set.

methods.name: getHasPrevious
methods.description:
Indicates whether there are more records before the current
page set.

methods.name: getListViewOptions
methods.description:
Returns a list of the listviews available to the current
user.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description:
Returns the page number of the current page set. Note that
the first page returns 1.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the number of records included in each page set.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description:
Returns the sObject that represents the changes to the
selected records. This retrieves the prototype object contained within
the class, and is used for performing mass updates.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description:
Returns the list of sObjects in the current page set. This
list is immutable, i.e. you can't call clear() on it.

methods.name: getResultSize
methods.description: Returns the number of records in the set.

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: Returns the list of sObjects that have been selected.

methods.name: last
methods.description:
Changes the set of records that the controller returns to the last
  page of records.

methods.name: next
methods.description:
Changes the set of records that the controller returns to the next
  page of records.

methods.name: previous
methods.description:
Changes the set of records that the controller returns to the
  previous page of records.

methods.name: save
methods.description:
Inserts new records or updates existing records that have
been changed. After this operation is finished, it returns a PageReference
to the original page, if known, or the home page.

methods.name: setFilterID
methods.description: Sets the filter ID of the controller.

methods.name: setpageNumber
methods.description: Sets the page number.

methods.name: setPageSize
methods.description: Sets the number of records in each page set.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description:
Set the selected records to the records specified in the
      selectedRecords argument.

name: AppLauncher Namespace
description:
The AppLauncher namespace
      provides methods for managing the
      appearance of apps in the App Launcher, including their visibility and sort
    order.

name: AppMenu
description:
Contains methods to set the appearance of apps in the App
      Launcher.

methods.name: setAppVisibility
methods.signature:
public static void setAppVisibility(Id appMenuItemId,
          Boolean isVisible)
methods.description: Shows or hides specific apps in the App Launcher.

methods.name: setOrgSortOrder
methods.description:
Sets the organization-wide default sort order for the App Launcher
      based on a List of app menu item IDs in the desired order.

methods.name: setUserSortOrder
methods.description:
Sets an individual user’s default sort order for the App Launcher
      based on a List of app menu item IDs in the desired order.

name: CommunityLogoController

This class and its methods are for internal use

name: EmployeeLoginLinkController

This class and its methods are for internal use

name: ForgotPasswordController

This class and its methods are for internal use

name: Approval Namespace
description:
The Approval namespace
provides classes and methods for approval processes.

name: LockResult
description: The result of a record lock returned by a System.Approval.lock() method.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description:
If an error occurred, returns an array of one or more database error
      objects, providing the error code and description.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the sObject you are trying to lock.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: A Boolean value that is set to true if the lock operation is successful for this object, or false otherwise.

name: ProcessRequest
description:
The ProcessRequest class is the parent class
        for the ProcessSubmitRequest and ProcessWorkitemRequest classes. Use the ProcessRequest class to write generic Apex that can
        process objects from either class.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description:
Returns the comments that have been added previously to
the approval request.

methods.name: getNextApproverIds
methods.description: Returns the list of user IDs of user specified as approvers.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets the comments to be added to the approval request.

methods.name: setNextApproverIds
methods.description:
If the next step in your approval process is another Apex approval process, you specify
    exactly one user ID as the next approver. If not, you cannot specify a user ID and this method
    must be null. This method sets the ActorId field of the
    associated ProcessInstanceWorkItem.

name: ProcessResult
description:
After you submit a record for approval, use the ProcessResult class to process the
results of an approval process.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: The ID of the record being processed.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description:
If an error occurred, returns an array of one or more database
error objects including the error code and description.

methods.name: getInstanceId
methods.description:
The ID of the approval process that has been submitted
for approval.

methods.name: getInstanceStatus
methods.description:
The status of the current approval process. Valid values
are: Approved, Rejected, Removed or Pending.

methods.name: getNewWorkitemIds
methods.description:
The IDs of the new items submitted to the approval process.
There can be 0 or 1 approval processes.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description:
A Boolean value that is set to true if the approval process completed successfully; otherwise,
it is set to false.

name: ProcessSubmitRequest
description:
Use the ProcessSubmitRequest class to submit a
    record for approval.

methods.name: getObjectId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the record that has been submitted for
approval. For example, it can return an account, contact, or custom
object record.

methods.name: getProcessDefinitionNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the developer name or ID of the process definition.

methods.name: getSkipEntryCriteria
methods.description:
If getProcessDefinitionNameOrId() returns a value other than null, getSkipEntryCriteria() determines whether to evaluate the entry criteria for the
   process (true) or not (false).

methods.name: getSubmitterId
methods.description:
Returns the user ID of the submitter requesting the approval record.
   The user must be one of the allowed submitters in the process definition setup.

methods.name: setObjectId
methods.description:
Sets the ID of the record to be submitted for approval.
For example, it can specify an account, contact, or custom object
record.

methods.name: setProcessDefinitionNameOrId
methods.description:
Sets the developer name or ID of the process definition to be
      evaluated.

methods.name: setSkipEntryCriteria
methods.description:
If the process definition name or ID is not null, setSkipEntryCriteria() determines whether to evaluate the
      entry criteria for the process (true) or not (false).

methods.name: setSubmitterId
methods.description:
Sets the user ID of the submitter requesting the approval record. The
      user must be one of the allowed submitters in the process definition setup. If you don’t set a
      submitter ID, the process uses the current user as the submitter.

name: ProcessWorkitemRequest
description:
Use the ProcessWorkitemRequest class for
    processing an approval request after it is submitted.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description:
Returns the type of action already associated with the
approval request. Valid values are: Approve, Reject, or Removed.

methods.name: getWorkitemId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the approval request that is in the process
of being approved, rejected, or removed.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the type of action to take for processing an approval request.

methods.name: setWorkitemId
methods.description:
Sets the ID of the approval request that is being approved,
rejected, or removed.

name: UnlockResult
description: The result of a record unlock, returned by a System.Approval.unlock() method.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description:
If an error occurred, returns an array of one or more database error
      objects, providing the error code and description.

methods.name: getId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the sObject you are trying to
    unlock.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: A Boolean value that is set to true if the unlock operation is successful for this object, or false otherwise.

name: Auth Namespace
description:
The Auth namespace provides an interface and
  classes for single sign-on into Salesforce and session security management.

name: AuthConfiguration
description:
Contains methods for configuring settings for
      users to log in to a Salesforce org using their authentication provider credentials instead of
      their Salesforce credentials. The authentication provider can be any authentication provider
      that supports the OpenID Connect protocol, such as Google, Facebook, or Twitter. Users log in
      to either an Experience Cloud site
        (https://MyDomainName.my.site.com) or your My Domain
      login URL
      (https://MyDomainName.my.salesforce.com).

methods.name: AuthConfiguration
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the AuthConfiguration
    class using the specified URL for an Experience Cloud site or a My Domain subdomain and the
    start URL for authenticated users.

methods.name: getAllowInternalUserLoginEnabled
methods.description:
Indicates whether the Experience Cloud site allows internal users to
      log in using the Experience Cloud site login page. To enable, admins configure the setting
        Allow internal users to log in directly to the experience on the
      Login & Registration page in Experience Workspaces. It’s disabled by
    default.

methods.name: getAuthConfig
methods.description:
Returns the AuthConfig sObject, which represents the
         authentication options for an Experience Cloud site or Salesforce My Domain
      subdomain.

methods.name: getAuthConfigProviders
methods.description:
Returns the list of authentication providers
         configured for an Experience Cloud site or Salesforce My Domain subdomain.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description:
Returns the list of authentication providers available
         for an Experience Cloud site or Salesforce My Domain subdomain.

methods.name: getAuthProviderSsoDomainUrl
methods.signature:
public static String getAuthProviderSsoDomainUrl(String
          communityUrl, String startUrl, String developerName)
methods.description:
Returns the single sign-on URL for an Experience Cloud site
      subdomain.

methods.name: getAuthProviderSsoUrl
methods.signature:
public static String getAuthProviderSsoUrl(String
                    communityUrl, String startUrl, String developerName)
methods.description:
Returns the single sign-on URL for an Experience
            Cloud site or Salesforce My Domain subdomain.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Returns the color for the background of the login page for a community.

methods.name: getCertificateLoginEnabled
methods.description:
Returns true if certificate-based authentication is enabled for the My
      Domain URL.

methods.name: getCertificateLoginUrl
methods.signature: public static String getCertificateLoginUrl(String domainUrl, String startUrl)
methods.description:
Returns the certificate-based authentication endpoint for the My
      Domain URL if the org has certificate-based authentication enabled.

methods.name: getDefaultProfileForRegistration
methods.description:
Returns the profile ID assigned to new community
  users.

methods.name: getFooterText
methods.description: Returns the text at the bottom of the login page for a community.

methods.name: getForgotPasswordUrl
methods.description:
Returns the URL for the standard or custom Forgot Password page that
      is specified for an Experience Cloud site or portal by the administrator.

methods.name: getHeadlessForgotPasswordEnabled
methods.description:
Returns true if the Headless
      Forgot Password Flow is enabled.

methods.name: getHeadlessFrgtPswEnabled
methods.description: This method will be deprecated in a future release. Use the getHeadlessForgotPasswordEnabled() method in this class instead.

methods.name: getHeadlessPasswordlessLoginEnabled
methods.description: Determines if headless passwordless login is enabled.

methods.name: getHeadlessRegistrationEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the Headless Registration Flow is enabled.

methods.name: getLogoUrl
methods.description: Returns the location of the icon image at the bottom of the login page for a community.

methods.name: getRightFrameUrl
methods.description:
Returns the URL for the right-frame content to display on the right
      side of the Experience Cloud site login page. The admin supplies the URL.

methods.name: getSamlProviders
methods.description:
Returns the list of SAML-based authentication providers
         available for an Experience Cloud site or Salesforce My Domain subdomain.

methods.name: getSamlSsoUrl
methods.signature:
public static String getSamlSsoUrl(String communityUrl,
          String startURL, String samlId)
methods.description:
Returns the single sign-on URL for an Experience Cloud site
      or Salesforce My Domain subdomain.

methods.name: getSelfRegistrationEnabled
methods.description:
Indicates whether the current community
      allows new users to create their own account by filling out a registration
    form.

methods.name: getSelfRegistrationUrl
methods.description:
Returns the location of the self-registration page for new users to sign up for an
  account with a community.

methods.name: getStartUrl
methods.description:
Returns the start page of an Experience Cloud site or
      Salesforce My Domain subdomain. This URL is the first page that users see when they log
      in.

methods.name: getUsernamePasswordEnabled
methods.description:
Indicates whether the current community is
      set to display a login form asking for a username and password. You can configure the community
      not to request a username and password if it is for unauthenticated users or users logging in
      with a third-party authentication provider.

methods.name: isCommunityUsingSiteAsContainer
methods.description:
Returns true if the Experience
      Cloud site uses Site.com pages; otherwise, returns false.

name: AuthProviderCallbackState
description:
Provides request HTTP headers, body, and query parameters to the
        AuthProviderPlugin.handleCallback method for user
      authentication. This class allows you to group the information passed in rather than passing
      headers, body, and query parameters individually.

methods.name: AuthProviderCallbackState
methods.signature:
public AuthProviderCallbackState(Map<String,String>
          headers, String body, Map<String,String> queryParameters)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the AuthProviderCallbackState class using the specified HTTP headers, body, and query
      parameters of the authentication request.

properties.name: body
properties.description: The HTTP body of the authentication request.

properties.name: headers
properties.description: The HTTP headers of the authentication request.

properties.name: queryParameters
properties.description:
The HTTP query parameters of the authentication
    request.

name: AuthProviderPlugin
description:
This interface is deprecated. For new development, use the abstract
      class Auth.AuthProviderPluginClass to create a custom
      OAuth-based authentication provider plug-in for single sign-on in to Salesforce.

methods.name: getCustomMetadataType
methods.description:
Deprecated as of API version 39.0. Use the corresponding method in
        Auth.AuthProviderPluginClass.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.signature:
public Auth.UserData getUserInfo(Map<String,String>
          authProviderConfiguration, Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse response)
methods.description:
Deprecated as of API version 39.0. Use the corresponding method in
        Auth.AuthProviderPluginClass.

methods.name: handleCallback
methods.signature:
public Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse
          handleCallback(Map<String,String> authProviderConfiguration,
          Auth.AuthProviderCallbackState callbackState)
methods.description:
Deprecated as of API version 39.0. Use the corresponding method in
        Auth.AuthProviderPluginClass.

methods.name: initiate
methods.signature:
public System.PageReference initiate(Map<String,String>
                    authProviderConfiguration, String stateToPropagate)
methods.description:
Deprecated as of API version 39.0. Use the corresponding method in
        Auth.AuthProviderPluginClass.

name: AuthProviderPluginClass
description:
Contains methods to create a custom OAuth-based authentication provider plug-in for
    single sign-on in to Salesforce. Use this class to create a custom authentication provider
    plug-in if you can’t use one of the authentication providers that Salesforce
    provides.

methods.name: getCustomMetadataType
methods.description:
Returns the custom metadata type API name for a custom OAuth-based
      authentication provider for single sign-on to Salesforce.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.signature:
public Auth.UserData getUserInfo(Map<String,String>
          authProviderConfiguration, Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse response)
methods.description:
Returns information from the custom authentication provider about
      the current user. This information is used by the registration handler and in other
      authentication provider flows.

methods.name: handleCallback
methods.signature:
public Auth.AuthProviderTokenResponse
          handleCallback(Map<String,String> authProviderConfiguration,
          Auth.AuthProviderCallbackState callbackState)
methods.description:
Uses the authentication provider’s supported authentication protocol
      to return an OAuth access token, OAuth secret or refresh token, and the state passed in when
      the request for the current user was initiated.

methods.name: initiate
methods.signature:
public System.PageReference
          initiate(Map<String,String> authProviderConfiguration, String
          stateToPropagate)
methods.description:
Returns the URL where the user is redirected for
      authentication.

methods.name: refresh
methods.signature:
public Auth.OAuthRefreshResult
          refresh(Map<String,String> authProviderConfiguration, String
        refreshToken)
methods.description:
Returns a new access token, which is used to update an expired
      access token.

name: AuthProviderTokenResponse
description:
Stores the response from the
        AuthProviderPlugin.handleCallback
      method.

methods.name: AuthProviderTokenResponse
methods.signature: public AuthProviderTokenResponse(String provider, String oauthToken, String oauthSecretOrRefreshToken, String state)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the AuthProviderTokenResponse class for a custom authentication provider plug-in using
      the specified arguments.

methods.name: AuthProviderTokenResponse
methods.signature:
public AuthProviderTokenResponse(String provider, String oauthToken,
          String oauthSecretOrRefreshToken, String state, String idToken)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the AuthProviderTokenResponse class for a custom authentication
    provider plug-in using the specified arguments. This constructor includes a parameter for the ID
    token.

properties.name: oauthSecretOrRefreshToken
properties.description:
The OAuth secret or refresh token for the currently logged-in
      user.

properties.name: oauthToken
properties.description: The OAuth access token.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: The authentication provider.

properties.name: state
properties.description:
The state passed in to initiate the authentication request for the
      user.

properties.name: idToken
properties.description: The ID token from the third party in encoded JWT format.

name: AuthToken
description:
Contains methods for getting and revoking access and refresh tokens that are issued when
    a user logs in via a single sign-on (SSO) flow that uses an authentication provider, such as
    Facebook.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.signature:
public static String getAccessToken(String authProviderId, String
     providerName)
methods.description:
Returns an access token for the current user using the specified 18-character identifier
    of an AuthProvider definition in your org and the proper name of the provider, such as
    Salesforce or Facebook.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMap
methods.signature:
public static Map<String, String>
          getAccessTokenMap(String authProviderId, String providerName)
methods.description:
Returns a map from the provider’s identifier to the access token for the currently
    logged-in Salesforce user. The identifier value depends on the provider. For example, for
    Salesforce, it’s the user ID, while for Facebook, it’s the user number.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.signature:
public static Map<String, String>
               refreshAccessToken(String authProviderId, String providerName, String
               oldAccessToken)
methods.description:
Returns a map from the third-party provider’s
         identifier containing a refreshed access token for the currently logged-in Salesforce
         user.

methods.name: revokeAccess
methods.signature:
public static Boolean revokeAccess(String authProviderId,
          String providerName, String userId, String remoteIdentifier)
methods.description:
Revokes the access token for a specified SSO user from a provider such as Facebook. You
    can use this method only if the IsNotSsoUsable field on the associated
    ThirdPartyAccountLink object is set to false.

name: CommunitiesUtil
description:
Contains methods for getting information about an
      Experience  Cloud user.

methods.name: getLogoutUrl
methods.description:
Returns the page to display after the current Experience
   Cloud user logs out.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description:
Returns the current user’s Experience Cloud display
   name.

methods.name: isGuestUser
methods.description:
Indicates whether the current user isn’t logged in to the
      Experience Cloud site. Redirect the user to log in, if necessary.

methods.name: isInternalUser
methods.description:
Indicates whether the current user is logged in as a
      member of the parent Salesforce organization, such as an employee.

name: ConfigurableSelfRegHandler
description:
Gives you more control over how customers or partners self-register
      for your Experience Cloud site by creating a class that implements Auth.ConfigurableSelfRegHandler. You choose the user
      information to collect, and how users identify themselves—with their email address,
      phone number, or another identifier. When verified, you create a customer or partner user and
      log in the user to your Experience Cloud site.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description:
Create a community member from the information that the visitor
      provided on your community’s self-registration page.

name: ConfirmUserRegistrationHandler
description:
Manages single sign-on (SSO) user mappings between Salesforce and a
      third-party identity provider. Use this interface to confirm user mappings before updating
      them.

methods.name: confirmUser
methods.signature:
public Id confirmUser(Id userId, Id tpalId, Id portalId,
          Auth.UserData userdata)
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the user to be logged in based on their mapping to a
      third-party identifier. This method is called before calling the updateUser() method. It's called only if the incoming user has previously
      logged in and has a third-party account link to a Salesforce user.

name: ConnectedAppPlugin
description:
Contains methods for extending the behavior of a connected app, for example,
    customizing how a connected app is invoked depending on the protocol used. This class gives you
    more control over the interaction between Salesforce and your connected app.

methods.name: authorize
methods.signature:
public Boolean authorize(Id userId, Id connectedAppId,
          Boolean isAdminApproved)
methods.description:
Deprecated and available only in API versions 35.0 and 36.0. As of

name: GeneratedUserData
description:
Stores the output of the Generate User Data invocable action, which you can access in
    Flow Builder.

methods.name: GeneratedUserData
methods.signature:
public GeneratedUserData(String firstName, String lastName, String
          email, String username, String alias, String languageLocaleKey, String localesIdKey,
          String emailEncodingKey, String timeZoneSidKey)
methods.description:
The Generate User Data action in Flow Builder uses this constructor to create an instance
    of the Auth.GeneratedUserData class.

properties.name: alias
properties.description:
Stores a generated placeholder value for the user's alias. The placeholder value is
      alias.

properties.name: email
properties.description:
Stores a generated placeholder value for the user's email address. The placeholder value
    is placeholder-email@example.com.

properties.name: emailEncodingKey
properties.description:
Stores the default value for the email encoding type for the user, such as UTF-8. The email encoding type determines how Salesforce encodes
    characters in outgoing emails. The default value is the email encoding key for the execution
    user specified in the Run As field in the authentication provider definition.

properties.name: firstName
properties.description:
Stores a generated placeholder value for the user's first name. The placeholder value
    is placeholder-first-name.

properties.name: languageLocaleKey
properties.description:
Stores the default value for the user's language, such as en_US for English. The default value is the language for the registration handler
    execution user. The execution user is specified in the Run As field in the authentication
    provider definition.

properties.name: lastName
properties.description:
Stores a generated placeholder value for the user's last name, also known as family
    name. The placeholder value is placeholder-last-name.

properties.name: localesIdKey
properties.description:
Stores the default value for the user's locale, defined using two-letter International
    Organization for Standardization (ISO) codes. For example, en_US indicates English (United States). The default value is the language for the
    registration handler execution user. The execution user is specified in the Run As field in the
    authentication provider definition.

properties.name: timeZoneSidKey
properties.description:
Stores the default value for the user's time zone, such as (GMT-07:00) Pacific Daylight Time (America/Los_Angeles). The time zone is defined
    using region and key city according to ISO standards. The default value is the time zone for the
    registration handler execution user. The execution user is specified in the Run As field in the
    authentication provider definition.

properties.name: username
properties.description:
Stores a generated placeholder value for the user's username. The placeholder value is
      placeholder-username<unique 14-character number>@example
      com, such as placeholder-username17370000000000@example
      com.

name: HeadlessSelfRegistrationHandler
description: Creates customer and partner users during the Headless Registration Flow.

public User createUser(Id profileId, Auth.UserData data, String

Returns a User object using information submitted by your off-platform app to Headless
    Registration API. The User object can be a new user that hasn’t been inserted in your org’s

name: HeadlessUserDiscoveryHandler
description:
Use this interface to create a headless user discovery handler that you implement during
    headless login, passwordless login, and forgot password flows.

methods.name: discoverUserFromLoginHint
methods.signature:
public Auth.HeadlessUserDiscoveryResponse discoverUserFromLoginHint(Id
          networkId, String loginHint, Auth.VerificationAction verificationAction, String
          customDataJson, Map<String,String> requestAttributes)
methods.description:
Finds a user's Salesforce account based on user information, such as their email address,
    phone number, or other data, that's passed to a Salesforce endpoint during headless login,
    passwordless login, and forgot password flows.

name: HeadlessUserDiscoveryResponse
description:
Contains methods to describe the result of headless user discovery using a handler that
    implements the Auth.HeadlessUserDiscoveryHandler interface
    during headless login, passwordless login, and forgot password flows.

methods.name: HeadlessUserDiscoveryResponse
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the Auth.HeadlessUserDiscoveryResponse class to describe the result of headless user
    discovery based on data passed into the login_hint during
    headless login, passwordless login, and forgot password flows.

properties.name: customErrorMessage
properties.description:
A custom error message that's returned if headless user discovery fails. For example,
    write custom logic in your headless user discovery handler to see if the user's email address is
    verified. Then return a custom error message for when it isn't verified.

properties.name: userIds
properties.description:
The user ID for the external user that's associated with the data passed into the login_hint parameter. If there are multiple users associated with
    the data, it can return multiple IDs, but headless user discovery fails.

name: HttpCalloutMockUtil
description: Contains a method to send fake HTTP callouts for classes in the Auth namespace.

methods.name: setHttpMock
methods.description: Mocks an HTTP callout using an implementation of the System.HttpCalloutMock interface.

name: IntegratingAppType
description:
Specifies whether you’re integrating your app as a connected app or as an external client
    app in methods used in your customized Apex token exchange handler, which extends the Auth.Oauth2TokenExchangeHandler class.

properties.name: CA
properties.description: Indicates a Salesforce connected app.

properties.name: ECA
properties.description: Indicates a Salesforce external client app.

name: InvocationContext
description:
The context in which the connected app is invoked, such as the
      protocol flow used and the token type issued, if any. Developers can use the context
      information to write code that is unique to the type of invocation.

properties.name: ASSET_TOKEN
properties.description: Reserved for future use.

properties.name: OAUTH1
properties.description: Context used when authentication is through ​an OAuth 1.0A flow.

properties.name: OAUTH2_JWT_BEARER_TOKEN
properties.description:
Context used when authentication is through a JSON-based Web Token (JWT) bearer
                token flow.

properties.name: OAUTH2_SAML_ASSERTION

Context used when authentication is through an OAuth 2.0 SAML assertion
                flow.

Context used when authentication is through an OAuth 2.0 username-password

Context used when issuing an ID token through an OAuth 2.0 user-agent

                flow.

properties.name: SAML_ASSERTION

properties.name: UNKNOWN

properties.name: USERID_ENDPOINT
properties.description: Context used when issuing an access token through a UserInfo endpoint.

If the attribute returned by the action is a boolean value, it's stored in this

If the attribute returned by the action is a Double value, it's stored in this

name: JWS
description:
Contains methods that apply a digital signature to a JSON Web Token
      (JWT), using a JSON Web Signature (JWS) data structure. This class creates the signed JWT
      bearer token, which can be used to request an OAuth access token in the OAuth 2.0 JWT bearer
      token flow.

methods.name: JWS
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the JWS
      class using the specified Auth.JWT payload and the
      certificate used for signing the JWT bearer token.

methods.name: JWS
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the JWS
      class using the specified payload and certificate used for signing the JWT bearer
    token.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Makes a duplicate copy of the JWS object.

methods.name: getCompactSerialization
methods.description:
Returns the compact serialization representation of the JWS as a
      concatenated string, with the encoded JWS header, encoded JWS payload, and encoded JWS
      signature strings separated by period ('.') characters.

name: JWT
description:
Generates the JSON Claims Set in a JSON Web Token (JWT). The resulting
      Base64-encoded payload can be passed as an argument to create an instance of the Auth.JWS class.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Makes a duplicate copy of the JWT object.

methods.name: getAdditionalClaims
methods.description:
Returns a map of additional claims in the JWT, where the key string
      contains the name of the claim, and the value contains the value of the
    claim.

methods.name: getAud
methods.description:
Returns the audience (aud) claim
      that identifies the intended recipients of the JWT.

methods.name: getIss
methods.description:
Returns the issuer (iss) claim that
      identifies the issuer of the JWT.

methods.name: getNbfClockSkew
methods.description:
Returns the not before (nbf) claim
      that identifies the time before which the JWT must not be accepted for processing, while
      allowing some leeway for clock skew. This method returns a NoAccess exception for JWTs generated using methods in the Auth.JWTUtil class. To return the nbf claim for these JWTs, use the getAdditionalClaims method instead.

methods.name: getSub
methods.description:
Returns the subject (sub) claim
      that identifies the current user of the JWT.

methods.name: getValidityLength
methods.description:
Returns the length of time (in seconds) that the JWT is valid, which
      affects the expiration (exp) claim. This method returns a
        NoAccess exception for JWTs generated using methods in
      the Auth.JWTUtil class. To return the validity length for
      these JWTs, use the getAdditionalClaims method
      instead.

methods.name: setAdditionalClaims
methods.description:
Sets the additional claims in the JWT. Returned by the getAdditionalClaims
    method.

methods.name: setAud
methods.description:
Sets the audience (aud) claim in
      the JWT. Returned by the getAud method.

methods.name: setIss
methods.description:
Sets the issuer (iss) claim in the
      JWT. Returned by the getIss method.

methods.name: setNbfClockSkew
methods.description:
Sets the not before (nbf) claim in
      the JWT. Returned by the getNbfClockSkew method. This
      method returns a NoAccess exception for JWTs generated
      using methods in the Auth.JWTUtil class. For these JWTs,
      the incoming JWT determines the nbf claim.

methods.name: setSub
methods.description:
Sets the subject (sub)  claim in
      the JWT. Returned by the getSub method.

methods.name: setValidityLength
methods.description:
Sets the length of time (in seconds) that the JWT is valid, which
      affects the expiration (exp) claim. Returned by the getValidityLength method. This method returns a NoAccess exception for JWTs generated using methods in the
        Auth.JWTUtil class. For these JWTs, the incoming JWT
      determines the validity length.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description:
Generates the JSON object representation of the Claims Set as an
      encoded JWT payload.

name: JWTBearerTokenExchange
description:
Contains methods that POST the signed JWT bearer token to a token
      endpoint to request an access token, in the OAuth 2.0 JWT bearer token flow.

methods.name: JWTBearerTokenExchange
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the JWTBearerTokenExchange class using the specified token endpoint and the signed JWT
      bearer token.

methods.name: JWTBearerTokenExchange
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Auth.JWTBearerTokenExchange class.

methods.name: clone
methods.description:
Makes a duplicate copy of the JWTBearerTokenExchange
    object.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description:
Returns the access_token in
      the token response to the JWT bearer token request.

methods.name: getGrantType
methods.description:
Returns the grant type specified in the JWT bearer token request. The
      grant type value defaults to urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer.

methods.name: getHttpResponse
methods.description:
Returns the full System.HttpResponse token response to the JWT bearer token
    request.

methods.name: getJWS
methods.description:
Returns the JWS specified in the JWT bearer token
    request.

methods.name: getTokenEndpoint
methods.description:
Returns the token endpoint that the JWT bearer token request is POSTed
      to.

methods.name: setGrantType
methods.description:
Sets the grant type in the JWT bearer token request. Returned by the
        getGrantType() method.

methods.name: setJWS
methods.description: Sets the JWS in the JWT bearer token request. Returned by the getJWS() method.

methods.name: setTokenEndpoint
methods.description:
Sets the token endpoint that the JWT bearer token request is POSTed
      to. Returned by the getTokenEndpoint()
    method.

name: JWTUtil
description:
Contains methods for validating a JSON Web Token (JWT) from an external identity provider
    as part of the OAuth 2.0 token exchange flow.  Use these methods as part of the validateIncomingToken method in the Auth.Oauth2TokenExchangeHandler class.

methods.name: parseJWTFromStringWithoutValidation
methods.description:
Parses a JWT from an encoded string into a header, payload, and signature. Use this
    method to decode the JWT without validating it.

methods.name: validateJWTWithCert
methods.signature: public static Auth.JWT validateJWTWithCert(String incomingJWT, String certDeveloperName)
methods.description:
Parses and validates the JWT using a certificate saved in Salesforce. The certificate can
    be self-signed or signed by a certificate authority.

methods.name: validateJWTWithKey
methods.signature: public static Auth.JWT validateJWTWithKey(String incomingJWT, String publicKey)
methods.description:
Parses and validates the JWT using a public key from the external identity
    provider.

methods.name: validateJWTWithKeysEndpoint
methods.signature: public static Auth.JWT validateJWTWithKeysEndpoint(String incomingJWT, String keysEndpoint, Boolean shouldUseCache)
methods.description:
Parses and validates the JWT using a remote JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) endpoint on your
    external identity provider.

name: LightningLoginEligibility
description:
Contains a Lightning Login eligibility value used by the Auth.SessionManagement.getLightningLoginEligibility
      method.

properties.name: ELIGIBLE
properties.description:
All eligibility conditions are met. The admin has enabled Salesforce
                Authenticator and Lightning Login, assigned the user Lightning Login user
                permission, and selected Allow only for users with the Lightning Login
                  User permission from the Session Settings Setup page. The user has set
                up Salesforce Authenticator and enrolled in Lightning Login.

properties.name: ORG_AUTHENTICATOR_NOT_ENABLED
properties.description: The admin hasn’t enabled Salesforce Authenticator.

properties.name: ORG_PREF_NOT_ENABLED
properties.description:
The admin hasn’t enabled Lightning Login. The Admin must select
                  Allow Lightning Login from the Session Settings Setup
                page.

properties.name: USER_AUTHENTICATOR_NOT_CONNECTED
properties.description: The user hasn’t set up Salesforce Authenticator.

properties.name: USER_NOT_ALLOWED
properties.description:
The admin hasn’t granted the user AllowLightningLogin user permission. Allowing
                Lightning Login to certain users requires the OnlyLLPermUserAllowed org preference.
                Admins must select Allow only for users with the Lightning Login User
                  permission from the Session Settings Setup page.

properties.name: USER_NOT_ENROLLED
properties.description: The user hasn’t enrolled in Lightning Login.

properties.name: USER_PERM_NOT_ENABLED
properties.description:
The admin hasn’t granted the user the Lightning Login Eligible user
                permission.

name: LoginDiscoveryHandler
description:
Salesforce gives you the ability to log in users based on other verification methods
    than username and password. For example, it can prompt users to log in with their email, phone
    number, or another identifier like a Federation ID or device identifier. Login Discovery is
    available to these licenses: Customer Community, Customer Community Plus, External Identity,
    Partner Community, and Partner Community Plus.

methods.name: login
methods.signature:
public System.PageReference login(String identifier, String
          startUrl, Map<String,String>requestAttributes)
methods.description:
Log in the customer or partner given the specified identifier, such
      as email or phone number. If successful, redirect the user to the Experience Cloud site page
      specified by the start URL.

name: LoginDiscoveryMethod
description:
Contains methods used to verify the user’s identity when the My
      Domain login process uses Login Discovery.

properties.name: LIGHTNING_LOGIN
properties.description:
Verify identity by Lightning Login, which lets internal users log in with
                Salesforce Authenticator.

properties.name: PASSWORD
properties.description: Verify identity by entering a password.

name: MyDomainLoginDiscoveryHandler
description:
The handler used to implement the My Domain Login Discovery page,
      which is an interview-based (two-step) login process. First the user is prompted for a unique
      identifier such as an email address or phone number. Then the handler determines (discovers)
      how to authenticate the user. Either the user enters a password or is directed to an identity
      provider’s login page.

methods.name: login
methods.signature:
public System.PageReference login(String identifier, String
          startUrl, Map<String,String> requestAttributes)
methods.description:
Log in a Salesforce user given the specified identifier, such as email or phone number.
    If successful, redirect the user to the page specified by the start URL.

name: Oauth2TokenExchangeHandler
description:
Use this class to create a token exchange handler that validates tokens from an external
    identity provider and maps the token’s subject to a Salesforce user during the OAuth 2.0 token
    exchange flow. The handler can also be used to create users by setting up a new User object and
    returning it to Salesforce for automatic insertion.

methods.name: getUserForTokenSubject
methods.signature: public User getUserForTokenSubject(Id networkId, Auth.TokenValidationResult result, Boolean canCreateUser, String appDeveloperName, Auth.IntegratingAppType appType)
methods.description:
Finds the subject defined in the external identity provider’s token so that it can be
    mapped to a Salesforce subject.

methods.name: validateIncomingToken
methods.signature: public Auth.TokenValidationResult validateIncomingToken(String appDeveloperName, Auth.IntegratingAppType appType, String incomingToken, Auth.OAuth2TokenExchangeType tokenType)
methods.description:
Validates an access token, refresh token, ID token, SAML 2.0 assertion, or JWT passed
    from an external identity provider during the OAuth 2.0 token exchange flow.

name: OAuth2TokenExchangeType
description:
Used during the OAuth 2.0 token exchange flow to
    specify the type of token that’s being exchanged for a Salesforce token.

properties.name: ACCESS_TOKEN
properties.description: An access token from the identity provider. The corresponding subject_token_type is urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token.

properties.name: ID_TOKEN
properties.description: An ID token from the identity provider. The corresponding subject_token_type is urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token.

properties.name: JWT
properties.description:
A token from the identity provider that’s formatted as a JSON Web Token (JWT). The
                corresponding subject_token_type is urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:JWT.

properties.name: REFRESH_TOKEN
properties.description: A refresh token from the identity provider. The corresponding subject_token_type is urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:refresh_token.

properties.name: SAML_2
properties.description: A SAML 2.0 assertion from the identity provider. The corresponding subject_token_type is urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:saml2.

name: OAuthRefreshResult
description:
Stores the result of an AuthProviderPluginClass
    refresh method. OAuth authentication flow provides a refresh token that can be used to get a new
    access token. Access tokens have a limited lifetime as specified by the session timeout value.
    When an access token expires, use a refresh token to get a new access token.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResult
methods.signature: public OAuthRefreshResult(String accessToken, String refreshToken, String error)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the OAuthRefreshResult class using the specified access token, refresh token, and
      error for a custom authentication provider plug-in.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResult
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the OAuthRefreshResult class using the specified access token and refresh token for a
      custom authentication provider plug-in. Use this method when you know that the refresh was
      successful.

properties.name: accessToken
properties.description: The OAuth access token for the user who is currently logged in.

properties.name: error
properties.description:
Error that occurs when a user unsuccessfully attempts to authenticate
      with the custom authentication provider.

properties.name: refreshToken
properties.description: The OAuth refresh token for the user who is currently logged in.

name: OauthToken
description:
Contains a method to revoke OAuth access tokens and refresh tokens. This method supports
    opaque tokens and JSON Web Token (JWT)-based access tokens, including guest and named user
    JWT-based access tokens.

methods.name: revokeToken
methods.signature: public static Boolean revokeToken(Auth.OauthTokenType type, String authToken)
methods.description: Revokes Salesforce-issued OAuth tokens.

name: OauthTokenType
description: Specifies the type of Salesforce-issued OAuth 2.0 token being revoked in the OauthToken.revokeToken method.

properties.name: ACCESS_TOKEN
properties.description:
An opaque access token, which Salesforce grants to a client when it
                successfully completes an authorization flow. Salesforce grants opaque access tokens
                by default.

properties.name: DELETE_TOKEN
properties.description:
A delete token, which can be queried and used to revoke refresh tokens and
                associated access tokens.

properties.name: REFRESH_TOKEN
properties.description:
A refresh token, which Salesforce grants to a client as a result of the refresh
                token flow. Refresh tokens are used to get more access tokens.

properties.name: ORG_JWT
properties.description:
A JSON Web Token (JWT)-based access token, which Salesforce grants to a client
                when it successfully completes an authorization flow. Salesforce grants JWT-based
                access tokens if you enable them for a connected app or external client app.

name: RegistrationHandler
description:
Salesforce provides the ability to use an authentication provider, such
as Facebook© or Janrain©, for single sign-on into Salesforce.

methods.name: createUser
methods.signature:
public User createUser(ID portalId, Auth.UserData
userData)
methods.description:
Returns a User object using the specified portal ID and user information from the third
        party, such as the username and email address. The User object corresponds to the third
        party’s user information. It can be a new user that hasn’t been inserted in
        your org’s database, or it can represent an existing user record in the database. If it’s a
        new User object, Salesforce inserts a user record for you.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.signature:
public Void updateUser(ID userId, ID portalId, Auth.UserData
     userData)
methods.description:
Updates the specified user’s information. This method is called if the user has
  logged in before with the authentication provider and then logs in again.

name: SamlJitHandler
description:
Use this interface to control and customize Just-in-Time user
      provisioning logic during SAML single sign-on.

methods.name: createUser
methods.signature:
public User createUser(Id samlSsoProviderId, Id communityId, Id
          portalId, String federationId, Map<String,String> attributes, String
          assertion)
methods.description:
Returns a User object using the specified Federation ID. The User
      object corresponds to the user information. This object can be a new user that hasn’t been
      inserted in the database or an existing user record in the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.signature:
public void updateUser(Id userId, Id samlSsoProviderId, Id
          communityId, Id portalId, String federationId, Map<String,String> attributes, String
          assertion)
methods.description:
Updates the specified user’s information. This method is called
      if the user has logged in before with SAML single sign-on and then logs in again, or if your
      application is using the Existing User Linking URL.

name: SessionManagement
description:
Contains methods for verifying users’ identity,
   creating custom login flows, customizing security levels, and defining trusted IP ranges for a
   current session.

methods.name: finishLoginDiscovery
methods.signature:
public static System.PageReference
          finishLoginDiscovery(Auth.LoginDiscoveryMethod method, Id userId)
methods.description:
Finishes the My Domain Login Discovery login
    process.

methods.name: finishLoginFlow
methods.description:
Finish the Visualforce Page login flow process, and redirect the
      user to the default home page.

methods.name: finishLoginFlow
methods.description:
Finish the Visualforce Page login flow process, and redirect the
      user to the specified start URL.

methods.name: generateVerificationUrl
methods.signature:
public static String
          generateVerificationUrl(Auth.VerificationPolicy policy, String description, String
          destinationUrl)
methods.description:
Initiates a user identity verification flow with the verification
      method that the user registered with, and returns a URL to the identity verification screen.
      For example, if you have a custom Visualforce page that displays
      sensitive account details, you can prompt the user to verify identity before viewing
    it.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description:
Returns a map of attributes for the current
      session.

methods.name: getLightningLoginEligibility
methods.description:
Returns the eligibility status for a user who’s logging in with
      Lightning Login when you set up your org with My Domain and use the Login Discovery page type.
      Use this method to redirect the user to a custom login flow. For example, use after a login
      attempt to redirect the user to password flow if the user is ineligible for Lightning
      Login.

methods.name: getQrCode
methods.description:
Returns a map containing a URL to a quick response (QR) code and
            a time-based one-time password (TOTP) shared secret to configure authenticator apps or
            devices for multi-factor authentication (MFA).

methods.name: getRequiredSessionLevelForProfile
methods.description:
Indicates the required login security session level for the given
      profile.

methods.name: ignoreForConcurrentSessionLimit
methods.description:
This method is reserved for internal Salesforce
    use.

methods.name: inOrgNetworkRange
methods.description:
Indicates whether the given IP address is within the organization's trusted IP range
    according to the organization's Network Access settings.

methods.name: isIpAllowedForProfile
methods.signature:
public static Boolean isIpAllowedForProfile(String profileId, String
          ipAddress)
methods.description:
Indicates whether the given IP address is within the trusted IP range for the given
    profile.

methods.name: setSessionLevel
methods.description: Sets the user's current session security level.

methods.name: validateTotpTokenForKey
methods.signature:
public static Boolean validateTotpTokenForKey(String
            sharedKey, String totpCode)
methods.description:
Deprecated. Use validateTotpTokenForKey(totpSharedKey, totpCode, description)
    instead.

methods.name: validateTotpTokenForKey
methods.signature:
public static Boolean validateTotpTokenForKey(String
          totpSharedKey, String totpCode, String description)
methods.description:
Indicates whether a time-based
        one-time password (TOTP) code (token) is valid for the given shared
    key.

methods.name: validateTotpTokenForUser
methods.description: Deprecated. Use validateTotpTokenForUser(totpCode, description) instead.

methods.name: validateTotpTokenForUser
methods.signature:
public static Boolean validateTotpTokenForUser(String totpCode,
          String description)
methods.description:
Indicates whether a time-based
        one-time password (TOTP) code (token) is valid for the current user.

methods.name: verifyDeviceFlow
methods.signature:
public static System.PageReference verifyDeviceFlow(String
     userCode, String startUrl)
methods.description:
Verifies the user code entered during the device authentication flow
      and redirects users to the OAuth approval page. If users aren’t logged in, they must log in.
      After successful login, users are prompted to allow the device to access Salesforce
    data.

name: SessionLevel
description: An Auth.SessionLevel enum value is used by the  SessionManagement.setSessionLevel method.

properties.name: LOW
properties.description:
The user’s security level for the
                                    current session meets the lowest requirements.
                                This low level is not available, nor used, in the Salesforce UI.
                                    User sessions through the Salesforce UI are either standard or
                                    high assurance. You can set this level using the API, but users
                                    assigned this level will experience unpredictable and reduced
                                    functionality in their Salesforce organization.

properties.name: STANDARD
properties.description:
The user’s security level for the
         current session meets the Standard requirements set in the current organization Session
         Security Levels.

properties.name: HIGH_ASSURANCE
properties.description:
The user’s security level for the current
         session meets the High Assurance requirements set in the current organization Session
         Security Levels.

name: TokenValidationResult
description:
Contains methods that describe the result of the token validation performed by a token
        exchange handler using the validateIncomingToken method
        in the Auth.Oauth2TokenExchangeHandler class during the
        OAuth 2.0 token exchange flow.

methods.name: TokenValidationResult
methods.signature: public TokenValidationResult(Boolean isValid, Object data, Auth.UserData userData, String token, Auth.OAuth2TokenExchangeType tokenType, String customErrorMsg)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the Auth.TokenValidationResult
    class to describe the result of token validation performed during the OAuth 2.0 token exchange
    flow.

methods.name: TokenValidationResult
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the Auth.TokenValidationResult class to describe a valid token validation result during
    the OAuth 2.0 token exchange flow.

methods.name: getCustomErrorMessage
methods.description:
Retrieves the CustomErrorMsg that’s returned when
    token validation fails.

methods.name: getData
methods.description:
Retrieves data from the identity provider token. This data can include custom data that
    isn’t stored in the userData property.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the token that was passed from the external identity provider.

methods.name: getTokenType
methods.description:
Retrieves the type of token that was passed from the external identity
    provider.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description:
Retrieves information about the user. The user information can be obtained from the
    identity provider’s token or from callouts to the identity provider, if applicable.

properties.name: customErrorMsg
properties.description: A custom error message that’s returned if token validation fails.

properties.name: data
properties.description:
Contains information about the user that isn’t stored in the Auth.UserData class, such as information obtained via callouts to the external
    identity provider.

properties.name: isValid
properties.description:
Indicates whether the token is valid or not, based on the custom validation logic in your
    token exchange handler.

properties.name: token
properties.description: The token from the external identity provider.

properties.name: tokenType
properties.description:
The type of token from the external identity provider. It can be an access token, refresh
    token, ID token, SAML 2.0 assertion, or a JSON Web Token (JWT).

properties.name: userData
properties.description:
Information about the user that’s obtained from the identity provider’s
    token.

properties.name: isValid
properties.description:
Indicates whether the token is valid or not, based on the custom validation logic in your
    token exchange handler.

name: UserData
description:
Stores user information for authentication provider registration handlers, including
    handlers that implement the Auth.RegistrationHandler
    interface and handlers built using Flow Builder.

methods.name: UserData
methods.signature:
public UserData(String identifier, String firstName,
                    String lastName, String fullName, String email, String link, String userName,
                    String locale, String provider, String siteLoginUrl, Map<String,String>
                    attributeMap)
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the Auth.UserData
        class using the specified arguments.

methods.name: UserData
methods.signature: public UserData(String identifier, String firstName, String lastName, String fullName, String email, String link, String username, String locale, String provider, String siteLoginUrl, Map<String,String> attributeMap, String idToken, String userInfoJSONString)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the Auth.UserData class that includes the ID token and user info
    response from the identity provider, if returned during single sign-on.

properties.name: identifier
properties.description:
An identifier from the third
party for the authenticated user, such as the Facebook user number
or the Salesforce user ID.

properties.name: firstName
properties.description:
The first name of the authenticated
user, according to the third party.

properties.name: lastName
properties.description:
The last name of the authenticated
user, according to the third party.

properties.name: fullName
properties.description:
The full name of the authenticated
user, according to the third party.

properties.name: email
properties.description:
The email address of the authenticated
user, according to the third party.

properties.name: link
properties.description:
A stable link for the authenticated
user such as https://www.facebook.com/MyUsername.

properties.name: username
properties.description:
The username of the authenticated
user in the third party.

properties.name: locale
properties.description:
The standard locale string for the authenticated
user.

properties.name: provider
properties.description:
The service used to log in,
such as Facebook or Janrain.

properties.name: siteLoginUrl
properties.description:
The site login page URL
passed in if used with a site; null otherwise.

properties.name: attributeMap
properties.description:
A map of data from the third
party, in case the handler has to access non-standard values. For
example, when using Janrain as a provider, the fields Janrain returns
in its accessCredentials dictionary
are placed into the attributeMap. These fields vary by provider.

properties.name: idToken
properties.description:
If provided, the ID token from the third party, formatted as an encoded JWT. The ID token
    contains claims with information about the authenticated user.

properties.name: userInfoJSONString
properties.description:
If provided, the user info response from the third party. The user info response is a
    JSON object containing user attributes. When used in this property, the JSON object is
    serialized into a string.

properties.name: idTokenJSONString
properties.description:
If provided, the ID token from the third party. The ID token is formatted as a JSON Web
    Token (JWT) containing claims with information about the user. When used in this property, the
    ID token is serialized into a string.

name: VerificationAction
description:
Indicates the method that you use to send a one-time password (OTP) to a user during the
    headless passwordless login flow.

properties.name: EMAIL
properties.description: Indicates that the user is verifying their identity with email.

properties.name: SMS
properties.description: Indicates that the user is verifying their identity with SMS.

name: VerificationMethod
description:
Contains the different ways users can identify themselves when
      logging in. You can use it to implement mobile-centric passwordless login pages and to
      self-register (and deregister) verification methods.

properties.name: BUILT_IN_AUTHENTICATOR
properties.description: Identity verified with a built-in authenticator.

properties.name: EMAIL
properties.description: Identity verified with a verification code sent in an email message.

properties.name: PASSWORD
properties.description: Identity verified with a password.

properties.name: SALESFORCE_AUTHENTICATOR
properties.description: Identity verified by Salesforce Authenticator.

properties.name: SECURITY_KEY
properties.description:
Identity verified by a WebAuthn-compatible physical security key. Includes all
                security keys registered or used after Summer ’22.

properties.name: SMS
properties.description: Identity verified with a verification code sent via SMS message.

properties.name: TOTP
properties.description: Identity verified with a time-based one-time password (TOTP).

properties.name: U2F
properties.description:
Identity verified by a U2F physical security key, such as a YubiKey.For U2F
                  security keys registered or used after Summer ’22, use SECURITY_KEY
                instead.

name: VerificationPolicy
description:
The Auth.VerificationPolicy
      enum contains an identity verification policy value used by the SessionManagement.generateVerificationUrl method.

properties.name: HIGH_ASSURANCE
properties.description:
The security level for the user’s current session must be High
                Assurance.

name: VerificationResult
description:
Contains the result of a verification challenge
      that you invoke when you create your own Verify page. The challenge can be initiated by either
      the System.UserManagement.verifyPasswordlessLogin or
        System.UserManagement.verifySelfRegistration
      method.

methods.name: VerificationResult
methods.signature:
public VerificationResult(System.PageReference redirect,
          Boolean success, String message)
methods.description: Creates an instance of the VerificationResult class that contains the verification result from System.UserManagement.verifySelfRegistration.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Duplicates the Auth.VerificationResult object.

properties.name: message
properties.description:
Message that displays as a result of a verification challenge.
        Token is valid if the identity verification is
      successful. Other values are FAILURE, PENDING, RATE_LIMITED, or
        FAILURE_REPORT.

properties.name: redirect
properties.description:
Where the user is directed after entering the verification code
      successfully, for example, the Experience Cloud site’s home page or location specified by the
      start URL.

properties.name: success
properties.description: The verification challenge is successful.

name: Auth Exceptions
description:
The Auth namespace contains some exception
    classes.

name: Cache Namespace
description:
The Cache namespace contains methods for managing
    the platform cache.

name: CacheBuilder
description:
An interface for safely retrieving and removing values from a
            session or org cache. Use the interface to generate a value that you want to store in
            the cache. The interface checks for cache misses, which means you no longer need to
            check for null cache values yourself.

methods.name: doLoad
methods.description:
Contains the logic that builds a cached value. You don’t call this
      method directly. Instead, it’s called indirectly when you reference the class that implements
      the CacheBuilder interface.

name: Org
description:
Use the Cache.Org class to
            add, retrieve, and manage values in the org cache. Unlike the session cache, the org
            cache is not tied to any session and is available to the organization across requests
            and to all users.

methods.name: contains
methods.description:
Returns true if the org
            cache contains a cached value corresponding to the specified key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description:
Returns true if the org
      cache contains values for the specified key entries.

methods.name: contains
methods.signature:
public static Map <String, Boolean> contains (Set<String>
     keys)
methods.description:
Returns true if the org cache contains values for a
    specified set of keys.

methods.name: get
methods.description:
Returns the cached value corresponding to the specified key from the
      org cache.

methods.name: get
methods.signature:
public static Object
          get(System.Type cacheBuilder, String
      key)
methods.description:
Returns the cached value corresponding to the specified key from the org
    cache. Use this method if your cached value is a class that implements the
    CacheBuilder interface.

methods.name: get
methods.signature:
public static Map <String, Object> get (Set <String>
     keys)
methods.description:
Returns the cached values corresponding to the specified set of keys
      from the org cache.

methods.name: getAvgGetSize
methods.description:
Returns the average item size of all the keys fetched from the org
      cache, in bytes.

methods.name: getAvgGetTime
methods.description:
Returns the average time taken to get a key from the org cache, in
      nanoseconds.

methods.name: getAvgValueSize
methods.description:
Deprecated and available only in API versions 49.0 and earlier.
      Returns the average item size for keys in the org cache, in bytes.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description:
Returns the percentage of org cache capacity that has been
    used.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description:
Returns a set of all keys that are stored in the org cache and visible
      to the invoking namespace.

methods.name: getMaxGetSize
methods.description:
Returns the maximum item size of all the keys fetched from the org
      cache, in bytes.

methods.name: getMaxGetTime
methods.description:
Returns the maximum time taken to get a key from the org cache, in
      nanoseconds.

methods.name: getMaxValueSize
methods.description:
Deprecated and available only in API versions 49.0 and earlier.
      Returns the maximum item size for keys in the org cache, in bytes.

methods.name: getMissRate
methods.description: Returns the miss rate in the org cache.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the default cache partition.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the total number of keys in the org cache.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description:
Returns a partition from the org cache that corresponds to the
            specified partition name.

methods.name: put
methods.signature:
public static void put(String key, Object
        value)
methods.description:
Stores the specified key/value pair as a cached entry in the org cache. The put method can write only to the cache in your org’s
    namespace.

methods.name: put
methods.signature:
public static void put(String key, Object value,
          Cache.Visibility visibility)
methods.description:
Stores the specified key/value pair as a cached entry in the org
      cache and sets the cached value’s visibility.

methods.name: put
methods.signature:
public static void put(String key, Object value, Integer
          ttlSecs)
methods.description:
Stores the specified key/value pair as a cached entry in the org
      cache and sets the cached value’s lifetime.

methods.signature:
public static void put(String key, Object value, Integer
          ttlSecs, cache.Visibility visibility, Boolean immutable)
methods.description:
Stores the specified key/value pair as a cached entry in the org
      cache. This method also sets the cached value’s lifetime, visibility, and whether it can be
      overwritten by another namespace.

Deletes the cached value corresponding to the specified key from the org
    cache.

methods.signature:

          Boolean remove(System.Type cacheBuilder, String
      key)
methods.description:
Deletes the cached value corresponding to the specified key from the org
    cache. Use this method if your cached value is a class that implements the
    CacheBuilder interface.

name: OrgPartition
description:
Contains methods to manage cache values in the org cache of a specific partition.
        Unlike the session cache, the org cache is not tied to any session. It’s available to the
        org across requests and to all users.

name: Partition
description:
Base class of Cache.OrgPartition and Cache.SessionPartition. Use the subclasses to manage the cache partition for org
      caches and session caches.

methods.name: contains
methods.description:
Returns true if the cache partition contains a
    cached value corresponding to the specified key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description:
Returns true if the cache partition contains values
    for a specified set of keys.

methods.name: createFullyQualifiedKey
methods.signature:
public static String createFullyQualifiedKey(String namespace,
          String partition, String key)
methods.description:
Generates a fully qualified key from the passed-in key components. The
      format of the generated key string is namespace.partition.key.

methods.name: createFullyQualifiedPartition
methods.signature:
public static String createFullyQualifiedPartition(String
          namespace, String partition)
methods.description:
Generates a fully qualified partition name from the passed-in
      namespace and partition. The format of the generated partition string is namespace.partition.
