methods.description:
Returns the cached value corresponding to the specified key from the cache
    partition.

Returns the cached values corresponding to the specified set of keys
      from the cache partition.

methods.name: get

      key)
methods.description:
Returns the cached value corresponding to the specified key from the
    partition cache. Use this method if your cached value is a class that
    implements the CacheBuilder interface.

methods.name: getAvgGetSize
methods.description:
Returns the average item size of all the keys fetched from the
      partition, in bytes.

methods.name: getAvgGetTime
methods.description:
Returns the average time taken to get a key from the partition, in
      nanoseconds.

methods.name: getAvgValueSize
methods.description:
Deprecated and available only in API versions 49.0 and earlier.
      Returns the average item size for keys in the partition, in bytes.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description:
Returns the percentage of cache used of the total capacity for this
      partition.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description:
Returns a set of all keys that are stored in the cache partition and
      visible to the invoking namespace.

methods.name: getMaxGetSize

Returns the maximum item size of all the keys fetched from the
      partition, in bytes.

methods.name: getMaxGetTime
methods.description:
Returns the maximum time taken to get a key from the partition, in
      nanoseconds.

methods.name: getMaxValueSize
methods.description:
Deprecated and available only in API versions 49.0 and earlier.
      Returns the maximum item size for keys in the partition, in bytes.

methods.name: getMissRate
methods.description: Returns the miss rate in the partition.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this cache partition.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the total number of keys in the partition.

methods.description:
Returns true if the Salesforce session is
    available. Only applies to Cache.SessionPartition. The
    session cache isn’t available when an active session isn’t present, such as in asynchronous Apex
    or code called by asynchronous Apex. For example, if batch Apex causes an Apex trigger to
    execute, the session cache isn’t available in the trigger because the trigger runs in

      partition. The put method can write only to the cache

      partition and sets the cached value’s visibility.

name: SalesforceResultCode
description:
Defines the gateway call status values in Salesforce based on the call
      status values that the payment gateway returned.

properties.name: Decline
properties.description:
The gateway call failed, but it may still work if you try again. For example, the customer
                had insufficient funds or briefly lost their connection to the internet. This is
                also known as a “soft decline.”

properties.name: Indeterminate
properties.description:
The gateway didn't respond to the call and the user has to check the transaction request’s
                status. Indeterminate responses often occur following server timeouts, system
                failure, or any action that interrupts the gateway’s ability to process the
                payment.

properties.name: PermanentFail
properties.description:
The customer’s bank recognized the payment account as closed, terminated, or fraudulent. The
                gateway won’t further calls from the payment method associate with the transaction.
                After a permanent fail response, the transaction changes its gateway status to
                Permanent Fail.

properties.name: RequiresReview
properties.description:
The gateway call initially failed, but the payment method may still work after further
                evaluation. This response often happens when the customer bank requires more
                information about the payment request. In this case, the bank provides an
                authorization code manually when the payment manager calls the processor.

properties.name: Success
properties.description: The gateway processed the transaction successfully.

properties.name: SystemError
properties.description:
Salesforce ended the payment request call before receiving a gateway response. System error
                responses often occur due to gateway server errors, invalid customer credentials, or
                anytime the request times out before receiving a gateway response. The failure
                occurs before the request reaches the gateway, so there’s no risk of an unaccounted
                payment remaining in the gateway. You can continue with the transaction by manually
                creating a payment.

properties.name: ValidationError
properties.description:
The gateway received incorrect customer payment information, such as misspelled credit card
                names or a CVV with missing numbers.

Sets the DocumentCode field. Document codes are often used to
      reference tax documents that the external tax engine uses in the tax calculation process.

      refunds.

methods.name: setEffectiveDate
methods.description:
Sets the EffectiveDate field. Effective Date fields are optional
      fields that store the date that a transaction takes effect. We provide these fields only for
      recordkeeping purposes – for example, if you must report an effective date to an
      external general ledger system. Salesforce doesn't use them to calculate any tax or payment
      values.

      item sent to an external tax engine for tax calculation.

      code of an additional document used in the tax calculation process. For example, use this
      field in case of a refund for a previously taxed purchase.

Sets the ID of a reference entity. In Commerce Tax, a reference
      entity represents a record related to the items sent to the external tax engine for tax
      calculation. For example, if you sent order items for tax calculation, you could define the
      parent order as the reference entity.

methods.name: setTaxTransactionId

      record. In Commerce Tax, a tax transaction record stores information about a specific tax
      calculation process.

      information about order summary sequences, which affect the newly created exchange order
      summary.

      action doesn’t cancel the associated OrderItemSummaries, so reallocate the canceled quantities
      to a new FulfillmentOrder.

methods.name: createFulfillmentOrders
methods.description:
Create one or more FulfillmentOrders and FulfillmentOrderLineItems
      for an OrderDeliveryGroupSummary, which defines a delivery method and recipient for an
      OrderSummary. You specify the OrderItemSummaries to allocate, which can be fulfilled from
      different locations. Specifying multiple fulfillment groups creates one FulfillmentOrder for
      each location. For each OrderItemSummary, a FulfillmentOrderLineItem is created and assigned
      to the corresponding FulfillmentOrder.

methods.signature:
public static
          ConnectApi.ReturnItemsOutputRepresentation returnItems(String returnOrderId,
          ConnectApi.ReturnItemsInputRepresentation
      returnItemsInput)
methods.description:
Process ReturnOrderLineItems belonging to a ReturnOrder. Processing
      a ReturnOrderLineItem generates a change Order and makes that ReturnOrderLineItem read-only.
      The change order for a returned item or delivery charge has a positive amount and should be
      used to create a credit memo. The change order for a return fee has a negative amount and
      should be used to create an invoice. If a processed ReturnOrderLineItem has any remaining
      expected quantity, then the API creates a separate ReturnOrderLineItem representing that
      quantity.

name: Routing
description: Route orders to inventory locations in Order Management.

methods.name: confirmHeldFOCapacity
methods.description:
Confirm held fulfillment order capacity at one or more locations.
      This call decreases a location’s held capacity and increases its assigned fulfillment order
      count. Confirm held capacity when you assign a fulfillment order to a
    location.

methods.name: findRoutesWithFewestSplits
methods.description:
Returns combinations of inventory locations that can fulfill an
      order within a specified limit of shipment splits. By default, checks up to 1,000,000
      potential routes, returning a maximum of 10,000 results.

methods.name: findRoutesWithFewestSplitsUsingOCI
methods.description:
For one or more order summaries, find inventory availability using
      Omnichannel Inventory and identify the fulfillment routes with fewest splits. By default,
      checks up to 1,000,000 potential routes, returning a maximum of 10,000 results. This method
      combines the functionality of the getInventoryAvailability() and findRoutesWithFewestSplits() methods.

methods.name: getFOCapacityValues
methods.description:
Get information about the current fulfillment order capacity of one
      or more locations.

methods.name: holdFOCapacity
methods.description:
Hold fulfillment order capacity at a location. Holding capacity at a
      location reserves a space for a fulfillment order that you’ll assign to it.

methods.name: rankAverageDistance
methods.description:
Calculates the average distance from sets of inventory locations to
      an order recipient, and ranks them. Use this method to compare the average shipping distances
      for different sets of locations that can fulfill an order. While this method is executing, you
      can’t invoke another Apex callout.

methods.name: releaseHeldFOCapacity
methods.description:
Release held fulfillment order capacity at one or more locations. This
      call decreases a location’s held capacity without changing its assigned fulfillment order
      count. Release held capacity when you cancel the assignment of a fulfillment order to a
      location.

methods.name: getError

providing the error code and description.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description:
Returns a String that contains an error
message.

methods.name: getErrorTypeName
methods.description:
Returns a String that contains the name
of the error type.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description:
Returns an object that contains the
results of the batch operation. The object is typed according to the
batch method. For example, if you call getMembershipBatch(), a successful call to BatchResult getResult() returns a ConnectApi.GroupMembership object.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description:
Returns a Boolean that is set to true if the batch operation was successful
for this object, false otherwise.

name: Batchable
description:
The class that implements this interface can be executed as a batch Apex
  job.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature:
public Void execute(Database.BatchableContext jobId,
     List<sObject> recordList)
methods.description:
Gets invoked when the batch job executes and operates on
one batch of records. Contains or calls the main execution logic for
the batch job.

methods.name: finish
methods.description:
Gets invoked when the batch job finishes. Place any clean
up code in this method.

methods.name: start
methods.description:
Gets invoked when the batch job starts. Returns the record
set as an iterable that will be batched for execution.

methods.name: start
methods.description:
Gets invoked when the batch job starts. Returns the record
set as a QueryLocator object that will be batched for execution.

name: BatchableContext
description:
Represents the parameter type of a batch job method and contains the batch job ID. This
  interface is implemented internally by Apex.

methods.name: getChildJobId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the current batch job chunk that is being
processed.

methods.name: getJobId
methods.description: Returns the batch job ID.

name: Cursor
description:
Contains methods to fetch records and to get the number of cursor rows returned from a
    SOQL query.

methods.name: fetch
methods.signature:
public static List<SObject> fetch(Integer position, Integer
          count)
methods.description:
Fetches cursor rows that correspond to the offset position and the specified record
    count. The maximum number of rows per cursor is 50 million, regardless of whether the operation
    is synchronous or asynchronous. Calling the Cursor.fetch()
    method counts against the SOQL query limit, and the rows fetched count against the SOQL query
    row limit. You can make a maximum of 100 Cursor.fetch() calls
    per transaction.

methods.name: getNumRecords
methods.description: Gets the number of rows returned in an Apex cursor from a Cursor.fetch(position, count) operation.

name: CursorFetchResult
description:
This class encapsulates the result of a PaginationCursor.fetchPage() call. It contains
    methods that get the rows for the current page, the start index of the next page, and the number
    of deleted rows skipped during the fetch operation. It also contains a method that indicates
    whether the pagination cursor has fetched all available rows in the result set.

methods.name: getNextIndex
methods.description:
Gets the start index required to fetch the next page of results. Use this value as the
      start parameter in the call to PaginationCursor.fetchPage(start, pageSize) to fetch the next page of
    results.

methods.name: getNumDeletedRecords
methods.description: Gets the number of deleted rows that were skipped during the fetch operation.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Gets the list of records that comprise the rows on the current page.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description:
Returns true if the pagination cursor has reached
    either the page size passed to PaginationCursor.fetchPage(start,
      pageSize) or the end of the result set. Otherwise returns false.

      execution.

      the remote operation is completed. This class provides the compensating transaction in the
      completion context of the insert or update operation. Extend this class to define the actions
      to execute after the remote insert or update operation finishes execution.

name: AuthenticationCapability
description:
Specifies the types of authentication that can be used to access the external
    system.

properties.name: ANONYMOUS
properties.description: No credentials are required to authenticate to the external system.

properties.name: BASIC
properties.description:
A username and password can be used to authenticate to the external
                system.

properties.name: CERTIFICATE
properties.description:
A security certificate can be supplied when establishing each connection to the
                external system.

properties.name: OAUTH
properties.description: OAuth can be used to authenticate to the external system.

name: AuthenticationProtocol
description:
Determines what type of credentials are used to authenticate to the external
    system.

properties.name: NONE
properties.description: No credentials are used to authenticate to the external system.

properties.name: OAUTH
properties.description: OAuth 2.0 is used to authenticate to the external system.

properties.name: PASSWORD
properties.description:
A username and password are used to authenticate to the external
                system.

name: Capability
description:
Declares which functional operations the external system supports. Also specifies
    required endpoint settings for the external data source definition.

properties.name: MULTI_PICKLIST
properties.description: The external system supports multi-picklist fields.

properties.name: PICKLIST
properties.description: The external system supports picklist fields.

properties.name: QUERY_PAGINATION_SERVER_DRIVEN
properties.description:
With server-driven paging, the external system determines the page sizes and
                batch boundaries. The external system’s paging settings can optimize the external
                system’s performance and improve the load times for external objects in your org.
                Also, the external data set can change while your users or the Lightning Platform
                are paging through the result set. Typically, server-driven paging adjusts batch
                boundaries to accommodate changing data sets more effectively than client-driven
                  paging.If you enable server-driven paging on an external data source,
                  Salesforce ignores the requested page sizes, including the default queryMore() batch size of 500 rows. The pages
                  returned by the external system determine the batches, but each page can’t exceed
                  2,000 rows. Also, the Apex code must generate a query token and use it to
                  determine and fetch the next batch of results.

properties.name: QUERY_TOTAL_SIZE
properties.description:
The external system can provide the total number of rows that meet the query
                criteria, even when requested to return a smaller batch size. This capability
                enables you to simplify how you paginate results by using queryMore().

properties.name: REQUIRE_ENDPOINT
properties.description:
Requires the administrator to specify the endpoint in the URL field in the
                external data source definition.

properties.name: REQUIRE_HTTPS
properties.description: Requires the endpoint URL to use secure HTTP. If REQUIRE_ENDPOINT isn’t declared, REQUIRE_HTTPS is ignored.

properties.name: ROW_CREATE
properties.description: Allows creating of external data.

properties.name: ROW_DELETE
properties.description: Allows deleting external data.

properties.name: ROW_QUERY
properties.description:
Allows API and SOQL queries of the external data. Also allows reports on the
                external objects.

properties.name: ROW_UPDATE
properties.description: Allows updating external data.

properties.name: SEARCH
properties.description:
Allows SOSL and Salesforce searches of the external data.When the custom
                  adapter declares the SEARCH capability,
                  you can control which external objects are searchable by selecting or deselecting
                    Allow Search on each external object. However, syncing
                  always overwrites the external object’s search status to match the search status
                  of the external data source.
Only text, text area, and long text area fields
                  on external objects can be searched. If an external object has no searchable
                  fields, searches on that object return no records.

properties.name: commitnumber
properties.description:
The system change number (SCN) of a committed transaction, which increases
    sequentially. This field is provided for diagnostic purposes. The field value is not guaranteed
    to be unique in Salesforce—it is unique only in a single database instance. If your Salesforce
    org migrates to another database instance, the commit number might not be unique or
    sequential.

properties.name: committimestamp
properties.description:
The date and time when the change occurred, represented as the number of milliseconds
    since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 GMT.

properties.name: commituser
properties.description: The ID of the user that ran the change operation.

properties.name: difffields
properties.description:
Contains the names of fields whose values are sent as a unified diff
      because they contain large text values.

properties.name: entityname
properties.description:
The API name of the standard or custom object that the change pertains to. For example,
    Account or MyObject__c.

properties.name: nulledfields
properties.description:
Contains the names of fields whose values were changed to null in an
      update operation. Use this field in Apex change event messages to determine if a field was
      changed to null in an update and isn’t an unchanged field.

properties.name: recordids
properties.description:
One or more record IDs for the changed records. Typically, this field contains one
    record ID. If in one transaction the same change occurred in multiple records of the same object
    type during one second, Salesforce merges the change notifications. In this case, Salesforce
    sends one change event for all affected records and the recordIds field
    contains the IDs for all records that have the same change.

properties.name: sequencenumber
properties.description:
The sequence of the change within a transaction. The sequence number starts from
    1.

properties.name: transactionkey
properties.description:
A string that uniquely identifies each Salesforce transaction. You can use this key to
    identify and group all changes that were made in the same transaction.

name: EventPublishFailureCallback
description:
Implement this interface to track platform event messages that failed to publish. The
      onFailure() method in this interface is called when the
    final result of the asynchronous publish operation becomes available.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description:
The system invokes this method when the final result of EventBus.publish is available and the publishing of the platform event message
        failed.

name: EventPublishSuccessCallback
description:
Implement this interface to track platform event messages that were published
        successfully. The onSuccess() method in this interface is
        called when the final result of the asynchronous publish operation becomes
        available.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description:
The system invokes this method when the final result of EventBus.publish is available and the publishing of the platform event message
        succeeded.

name: FailureResult
description:
Contains the result of an Apex publish callback when the event publishing failed.
        This interface is used as a parameter in the onFailure
        method of the EventPublishFailureCallback
        interface.

methods.name: getEventUuids
methods.description:
Returns a list of EventUuid field values of each
        platform event that is included in EventBus.EventPublishFailureCallback.

name: SuccessResult
description:
Contains the result of an Apex publish callback when the event publishing succeeded.
        This interface is used as a parameter in the onSuccess
        method of the EventPublishSuccessCallback
        interface.

methods.name: getEventUuids
methods.description:
Returns a list of EventUuid field values of each
        platform event that is included in the EventBus.EventPublishSuccessCallback.

name: TestBroker
description:
Contains methods that simulate the successful delivery or failed
      publishing of platform event or change event messages in an Apex test.

methods.name: deliver
methods.description:
Delivers platform event messages to the test event bus. Use this
      method to deliver test event messages multiple times and verify that event subscribers have
      processed the test events each step of the way.

methods.name: fail
methods.description:
Causes the publishing of platform event messages to fail in the test event bus. Use
        this method to test Apex publish callbacks.

name: TriggerContext
description:
Provides information about the platform event or change event trigger
      that’s currently executing, such as how many times the trigger was retried due to the EventBus.RetryableException. Also, provides a method to
      resume trigger executions.

methods.name: currentContext
methods.description:
Returns an instance of the EventBus.TriggerContext class containing information about the currently executing
      trigger.

methods.name: getResumeCheckpoint
methods.description:
Returns the replay ID that was set by setResumeCheckpoint(). The returned value is the replay ID of the event message
      after which trigger processing resumes in a new trigger invocation.

methods.name: setResumeCheckpoint
methods.description:
Sets a checkpoint in the event stream where the platform event trigger
      resumes execution in a new invocation. Use this method to recover from limit and uncaught
      exceptions, or to control the number of events processed in one trigger execution. When
      calling this method, pass in the replay ID of the last successfully processed event message.
      When the trigger stops execution before all events in Trigger.New are processed, either because of an uncaught exception or
      intentionally, the trigger is invoked again. The new execution starts with the event message
      in the stream after the one with the checkpointed Replay ID.

properties.name: lastError
properties.description: Read-only. The error message that the last thrown EventBus.RetryableException contains.

properties.name: retries
properties.description:
Read-only. The number of times the trigger was retried due to throwing
      the EventBus.RetryableException.

The FormulaEval namespace provides classes and methods to evaluate dynamic formulas for

methods.name: parseAsTemplate
methods.description:
Optional. Indicates whether a formula expression created with the build() method is evaluated in template mode. In template
    mode, values are interpolated into a string by using merge field syntax rather than by
    concatenating strings with the & operator. Merge
    fields use the syntax {!Object_Name.Field_Name}, where
    names are preceded by an exclamation mark and enclosed in curly braces.

methods.name: treatNumericNullAsZero
methods.description:
Optional. Indicates whether a null for a numeric data type is treated as zero while
    evaluating the formula with the build()

methods.name: withGlobalVariables

methods.name: withReturnType

Required. Sets the formula output data type for the formula instance created with the

methods.name: withType

Use the Function class to access deployed Salesforce Functions, and

Returns the Function instance for the named Function and Project. The

methods.description: Invokes the Function asynchronously.

Represents the callback Salesforce calls when an asynchronous, queued

Called when an asynchronous Function invocation has

description: Represents the error type of FunctionInvocationError.

properties.name: FUNCTION_EXCEPTION
properties.description:
A known exception resulting from the Function logic itself. Examples include an exception
                thrown from the Function code, or an exception thrown from a library or framework
                the Function uses.

properties.name: RUNTIME_EXCEPTION
properties.description:
A known exception resulting from the Salesforce Functions runtime. For example, a malformed
                payload passed to the Function when invoked results in this error type.

properties.name: UNEXPECTED_FUNCTION_EXCEPTION
properties.description:
An unknown exception. For example, a network or system-level issue within the Salesforce
                Functions infrastructure results in this error type.

Contains base email methods common to both single and mass

methods.name: setBccSender
methods.description:
Indicates whether the email sender receives a copy of the email that is sent. For a mass
  mail, the sender is only copied on the first email sent.

methods.name: setReplyTo
methods.description:
Optional. The email address that receives the message when
a recipient replies.

methods.name: setTemplateID
methods.description:
The ID of the template to be merged to create this email. Specify a value for
   setTemplateId, setHtmlBody, or
   setPlainTextBody. Or, you can define both setHtmlBody
  and setPlainTextBody.

methods.name: setSaveAsActivity
methods.description:
Optional. The default value is true, meaning the email is saved
as an activity. This argument only applies if the recipient list is
based on targetObjectId or targetObjectIds. If HTML email tracking is enabled for the organization, you will
be able to track open rates.

methods.name: setSenderDisplayName
methods.description:
Optional. The name that appears on the From line of the
email. This cannot be set if the object associated with a setOrgWideEmailAddressId for a SingleEmailMessage has
defined its DisplayName field.

methods.name: setUseSignature
methods.description:
Indicates whether the email includes an email signature
if the user has one configured. The default is true, meaning if the user has a signature
it is included in the email unless you specify false.

properties.name: authenticationResultFields
properties.description:
Additional information in authentication result headers. Examples include: name: smtp.mailfrom and value:
      example.com.

properties.name: method
properties.description:
The authentication method used for the security check. Possible values include dkim, dmarc, or
      spf.

properties.name: result
properties.description:
The result of the authentication check. When the email service is configured to verify
    the legitimacy of the sending server before processing a message, possible values include

Returns the map of custom headers previously set for the email. Returns null if no custom

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: The name of the template used to create the email.

methods.name: setBccAddresses
methods.description:
Optional. A list of blind carbon copy (BCC) addresses or object IDs of the contacts,
      leads, and users you’re sending the email to. The maximum size for this field is 4,000 bytes.
      The maximum total of toAddresses, ccAddresses, and
         bccAddresses per email is 150. All recipients in these three fields
      count against the limit for email sent using Apex or the API.

methods.name: setCcAddresses
methods.description:
Optional. A list of carbon copy (CC) addresses or object IDs of the contacts, leads,
        and users you’re sending the email to. The maximum size for this field is 4,000 bytes. The
        maximum total of toAddresses, ccAddresses, and
            bccAddresses per email is 150. All recipients in these three fields
        count against the limit for email sent using Apex or the API.

methods.name: setCharset
methods.description:
Optional. The character set for the email. If this value
is null, the user's default value is used.

methods.name: setCustomHeaders
methods.description:
Optional. Sets custom headers to include in the outgoing email. Each header name must
    be prefixed with X-SFDC-X-. If a header name doesn’t have
    this prefix, Salesforce automatically adds it. Salesforce enforces this prefix to ensure
    security and compliance with internal protocols. All header names and values must comply with
    RFC 822 and RFC 5322 specifications. Avoid duplicate headers.

methods.name: setDocumentAttachments
methods.description:
(Deprecated. Use setEntityAttachments()
   instead.) Optional. A list containing the ID of each document object you want to attach to
  the email.

methods.name: setEntityAttachments
methods.description:
Optional. Array of IDs of 
				Document, 
				ContentVersion, or 
				Attachment items to attach to the
    email.

methods.name: setFileAttachments
methods.description:
Optional. A list containing the file names of the binary
and text files you want to attach to the email.

methods.name: setHtmlBody
methods.description:
Optional. The HTML version of the email, specified by the sender. The value is encoded
  according to the specification associated with the organization. Specify a value for
   setTemplateId, setHtmlBody, or
   setPlainTextBody. Or, you can define both setHtmlBody
  and setPlainTextBody.

methods.name: setInReplyTo
methods.description:
Sets the optional In-Reply-To field of the outgoing email. This field identifies the
    email or emails to which this email is a reply (parent emails).

methods.name: setOneClickPost
methods.description:
Optional. If set to true, a List-Unsubscribe-Post header is added to an email with
    List-Unsubscribe=One-Click. Use this method to support unsubscribe functionality in email sent
    via Salesforce. You can provide additional instructions on how to send unsubscribe requests by
    using the header. This includes specifying the HTTP method and content type to use and provides
    a secure way to add more info to unsubscribe requests. Default is false.

methods.name: setOptOutPolicy
methods.description:
Optional. If you added recipients by ID instead of email address and
      the Email Opt Out option is set, this method determines the behavior of
      the sendEmail() call. If you add recipients by their
      email addresses, the opt-out settings for those recipients aren’t checked and those recipients
      always receive the email.

methods.name: setPlainTextBody
methods.description:
Optional. The text version of the email, specified by the sender. Specify a value for
   setTemplateId, setHtmlBody, or
   setPlainTextBody. Or, you can define both setHtmlBody
  and setPlainTextBody.

methods.name: setOrgWideEmailAddressId
methods.description:
Optional. The ID of the organization-wide email address associated with the outgoing
    email. If you’re using Apex to send emails from the guest user, set the sender to the verified
    org-wide email address or the emails are blocked. The object's DisplayName
    field cannot be set if the setSenderDisplayName field is already
    set.

methods.name: setReferences
methods.description:
Optional. The References field of the outgoing email. Identifies
an email thread. Contains the parent emails' References and message
IDs, and possibly the In-Reply-To fields.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description:
Optional. The email subject line. If you are using an email
template, the subject line of the template overrides this value.

methods.name: setTargetObjectId
methods.description:
Required if using a template, optional otherwise. The ID of the contact, lead, or user
  to which the email will be sent. The ID you specify sets the context and ensures that merge fields
  in the template contain the correct data.

methods.name: setTemplateId
methods.description:
Required if using a template, optional otherwise. The ID of the template used to create
  the email.

methods.name: setToAddresses
methods.description:
Optional. A list of email addresses or object IDs of the contacts, leads, and users
    you’re sending the email to. The maximum size for
      this field is 4,000 bytes. The maximum total of toAddresses,
        ccAddresses, and bccAddresses per email is 150.
      All recipients in these three fields count against the limit for email sent using Apex or the
      API.

methods.name: setTreatBodiesAsTemplate
methods.description:
Optional. If set to true, the
      subject, plain text, and HTML text bodies of the email are treated as template data. The merge
      fields are resolved using the renderEmailTemplate
      method. Default is false.

methods.name: setTreatTargetObjectAsRecipient
methods.description:
Optional. If set to true, the
        targetObjectId (a contact, lead, or user) is the recipient of the
      email. If set to false, the
        targetObjectId is supplied as the WhoId field for
      template rendering but isn’t a recipient of the email. The default is true.

methods.name: setUnsubscribeComment
methods.description:
Optional. Sets a comment in the List-Unsubscribe email header. This comment is ignored by
    email clients and systems that parse the header. The comments contain human-readable notes or
    context for developers, administrators, or other stakeholders managing the email
    system.

methods.name: setUnsubscribeUrls
methods.description:
Optional. Sets a mailto URI and HTTP URL
    of a mechanism for unsubscribing a recipient from an email list. A list of all unsubscribe URLs
    passed through setUnsubscribeUrls is added to
    the List-Unsubscribe header. A minimum of one URL is required
    to use this method.

methods.name: setWhatId
methods.description:
If you specify a contact for the targetObjectId field, you can
        specify an optional whatId as well. This helps to further ensure that
        merge fields in the template contain the correct data.

properties.name: stateDetail

properties.name: success
properties.description:

properties.name: InProgress

properties.name: SucceededPartial

name: Pref_center Namespace

The Pref_center namespace provides an interface, classes, and methods to create and
    retrieve data in forms in Preference Manager. Preference Manager, previously called Preference
    Center, is a feature within the Privacy Center app.

name: LoadFormData
description:
Retrieve records related to the tokenized record id, and populate the
            values of a preference form.

methods.name: LoadFormData
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the LoadFormData class for running tests on any custom Apex classes you create for
      Preference Manager.

methods.name: addOption
methods.signature: public void addOption(String fieldId, String value, String label)
methods.description:
Add an option for a checkbox, picklist, or radio button field in a
      preference form using the label and value.

methods.name: addOption
methods.signature: public void addOption(String fieldId, System.SelectOption option)
methods.description:
Add a defined, selectable option for a checkbox, picklist, or radio
      button field in a preference form.

methods.name: addSelectedOption
methods.signature: public void addSelectedOption(String fieldId, String option)
methods.description:
Add a selected option for a checkbox field in a preference form. This
      requires the field on the form to have a defined option with a set value.

methods.name: setButtonLabel
methods.signature: public void setButtonLabel(String fieldId, String label)
methods.description:
Set the label of a button added to the preference
    form.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.signature: public void setOptions(String fieldId, List<System.SelectOption> options)
methods.description:
Add a list of selectable options for a field on a preference
      form.

methods.name: setSelectedOption
methods.signature: public void setSelectedOption(String fieldId, String optionValue)
methods.description:
For a picklist or radio button field on a preference form that has
      defined values, set the value entered in the optionValue field as the selected
    option.

methods.name: setSelectedOptions
methods.signature: public void setSelectedOptions(String fieldId, List<String> options)
methods.description:
For an existing checkbox field on a preference form that has defined
      values, set the values entered in the options field as the selected options. This requires the
      field on the form to have defined options with a set value.

methods.name: setTextHint
methods.signature: public void setTextHint(String fieldId, String hintText)
methods.description:
Set the hint text inside a text input field. The hint text tells the
      user what type of information to enter, like an email address.

methods.name: setTextValue
methods.signature: public void setTextValue(String fieldId, String value)
methods.description: Set the value of a text field in a preference form.

name: LoadParameters
description:
Contains methods to retrieve record Id information for parameters
      passed into the load-form handler.

methods.name: getRecordId
methods.description: Returns the untokenized version of the record Id.

name: PreferenceCenterApexHandler
description:
Pass data between your organization and a form in Preference
      Manager.

methods.name: load
methods.signature:
public pref_center.LoadFormData load(pref_center.LoadParameters
          loadParams, pref_center.LoadFormData formData, pref_center.ValidationResult
          validationResult)
methods.description:
Retrieve the record IDs and initial values from a preference form
      before it is edited and submitted.

methods.name: submit

Updates the changed values of fields when the preference form is
      submitted.

name: SubmitFormData
description:
Contains methods to retrieve information on buttons and options
      selected in a preference form.

methods.name: getButtonClicked
methods.description:
Returns the field ID of the button that was clicked in the preference
      form. For example, use this method to determine if the clicked button was
        Submit or Cancel.

methods.name: getOldSelectedValue
methods.description:
Returns the value that was set for the specified field when the
      preference form was previously edited by the user. This method is used for field types such as
      picklist or radio buttons.

methods.name: getOldSelectedValues
methods.description:
Returns a list of the string values that were set on a checkbox field
      when the preference form was previously edited by the user.

methods.name: getOldStringValue
methods.description:
Returns the string value that was set on a field when the preference
      form was loaded. This method is used for field types such as text, and throws a TypeException
      if used with a field that can return more than one value, like a checkbox
    field.

methods.name: getSelectedValue
methods.description:
Returns the string value that is currently selected for a picklist or
      radio button field in the preference form.

methods.name: getSelectedValues
methods.description:
Returns a list of string values that are currently selected on a
      checkbox field in the preference form.

methods.name: getStringValue
methods.description:
Returns the string value that was set on a field when the preference
      form was loaded. This method is used for field types such as text.

name: SubmitParameters
description:
Retrieve record ID information to use with your submit-form
      handler.

methods.name: getRecordId
methods.description: Returns the untokenized version of the record ID.

name: TokenType
description: Defines the types of values supported by the TokenUtility methods.

properties.name: EMAIL
properties.description: Identifies the token as an email address.

properties.name: STANDARD
properties.description: Identifies the token as a Salesforce record ID. This is the default token type.

name: TokenUtility
description:
Generate authentication tokens to access preference
        forms.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.signature: public static String generateToken(String tokenValue, pref_center.TokenType tokenType)
methods.description:
Returns the authentication token for the specified token value using
      the given token type.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description:
Returns the authentication token for the specified token value using
      the default standard token type.

methods.name: generateTokens
methods.signature: public static Map<String,String> generateTokens(List<String> tokenValues, pref_center.TokenType tokenType)
methods.description:
Returns the authentication tokens in the form of a map, where the map
      key is the input value to be tokenized and the map value is the corresponding token. The given
      token type is used to generate the tokens.

methods.description:
Returns the generated tokens in the form of a map. This method uses
      the default standard token type to generate the tokens.

name: ValidationResult

This class is reserved for future use with Preference
    Manager.

A value that can only be assigned true,

name: QuickAction Namespace
description:
The QuickAction namespace provides classes and
    methods for quick actions.

name: DescribeAvailableQuickActionResult
description:
Contains describe metadata information for a quick action
that is available for a specified parent.

methods.name: getActionEnumOrId
methods.description:
Returns the unique ID for the action. If the action doesn’t have an
      ID, its API name is used.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: The quick action label.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: The quick action name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: The quick action type.

name: DescribeLayoutComponent
description:
Represents the smallest unit in a layout—a field
or a separator.

methods.description:
Returns the vertical lines displayed for a field. Applies
to textarea and multi-select picklist fields.

methods.name: getTabOrder
methods.description: Returns the tab order for the item in the row.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the name of the QuickAction.DescribeLayoutComponent type for this component.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the field if the type for QuickAction.DescribeLayoutComponent is textarea.

name: DescribeLayoutItem
description: Represents an individual item in a QuickAction.DescribeLayoutRow.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label text for this item.

methods.name: getLayoutComponents
methods.description: Returns a list of QuickAction.DescribeLayoutComponents for this item.

methods.name: isEditableForNew
methods.description: Indicates whether this item can be edited for new (true) or not (false).

methods.name: isEditableForUpdate
methods.description: Indicates whether this item can be edited for update(true) or not (false).

methods.name: isPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates whether this item is a placeholder (true) or not (false). If true, then this item is blank.

methods.description: Indicates whether this item is required (true) or not (false).

name: DescribeLayoutRow
description: Represents a row in a QuickAction.DescribeLayoutSection.

methods.description:
Returns either a specific field or an empty QuickAction.DescribeLayoutItem (one
that contains no QuickAction.DescribeLayoutComponent objects).

methods.name: getNumItems
methods.description: Returns the number of QuickAction.DescribeLayoutItem.

name: DescribeLayoutSection
description:
Represents a section of a layout and consists of one or
more columns and one or more rows (an array of QuickAction.DescribeLayoutRow).

methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the QuickAction.DescribeLayoutSection.

methods.name: getHeading

Returns the ID of the record details section in the

Indicates whether the record details section is collapsed (true) or expanded (false).
      If you build your own app, you can use this method to see whether the current user collapsed a

      running the standard Email Action on Case Feed and the container of the Email Message fields

      is rendered.

Returns the type of the standard Email Action on Case Feed
      (Email).

The target object of the standard Email Action on Case Feed

The QuickAction.QuickActionDefaultsHandler interface lets you specify the default
      values for the standard Email and Send Email actions in the case feed. You can use this
      interface to specify the From address, CC address, BCC address, subject, and email body for the Email
      action in the case feed. You can use the interface to pre-populate these fields based on the
      context where the action is displayed, such as the case origin (for example, country) and
      subject.

methods.description:
Implement this method to provide default values for the standard
      Email action in the case feed.

Use the QuickAction.QuickActionRequest class for providing action information for quick
   actions to be performed by QuickAction class methods.

Represents an Apex class that provides: the From address list; the

      message feed item; and methods to specify related settings on templates. You can override
      these fields before the standard Email Action is rendered.

Returns a list of email addresses that are available in the From:
      address drop-down menu for the standard Email Action.

methods.description:
Returns the email message ID of the email to which the reply/reply all
      action has been invoked.

Specifies whether the template subject should be ignored (true), thus
      using the original subject, or whether the template subject should replace the original
      subject (false).

      body (false).

formula field.

name: ReportScopeInfo
description:
Contains information about possible scope values that you can choose.
      Scope values depend on the report type. For example, you can set the scope for opportunity
      reports to All opportunities, My team’s opportunities, or My
      opportunities.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description:
Returns the default scope of the data to display in the
    report.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description:
Returns a list of scope values specified for the
    report.

description:
Contains information about a possible scope value. Scope values depend
      on the report type. For example, you can set the scope for opportunity reports to All opportunities, My team’s
        opportunities, or My
    opportunities.

methods.name: getAllowsDivision
methods.description:
Returns a boolean value that indicates whether you can segment the
      report by this scope.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the display name of the scope of the report.

methods.name: getValue

name: ReportType

Contains the unique API name and display name for the report
type.

description:
Contains detailed report type metadata about a field, including
data type, display name, and filter values.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the field.

methods.name: getFilterValues
methods.description:
If the field data type is picklist, multi-select picklist,
boolean, or checkbox, returns all filter values for a field. For example,
checkbox fields always have a value of true or false. For
fields of other data types, the filter value is an empty array, because
their values can’t be determined.

methods.name: getFilterable
methods.description:
If the field is of a type that can’t be filtered,
returns False. For example, fields
of the type Encrypted Text can’t be filtered.

methods.name: getName

description: Information about categories of fields in a report type.

methods.description:
Returns information for all fields in the report type.
The information is organized by each section’s unique API name.

methods.description:
Returns the localized display name of a section in the
report type under which fields are organized. For example, in an Accounts
with Contacts custom report type, Account
General is the display name of the section that contains
fields on general account information.

name: ReportTypeMetadata
description:
Contains report type metadata, which gives you information
about the fields that are available in each section of the report
type, plus filter information for those fields.

Returns all fields in the report type. The fields are organized
by section.

methods.name: getScopeInfo

      of report.

Returns information about the standard date filter groupings that can
      be applied to this type of report. Standard date filter groupings include Calendar Year,
      Calendar Quarter, Calendar Month, Calendar Week, Fiscal Year, Fiscal Quarter, Day and a custom
      value based on a user-defined date range.

Returns information about standard date filters that can be applied to
      this type of report.

    report.

name: StandardDateFilter

Contains information about standard date filter available in the
      report—for example, the API name, start date, and end date of the standard date filter

    placed.

Returns the API name of the standard date filter

Returns duration information about a standard date filter, such as
      start date, end date, and display name and API name of the date filter.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the standard date filter.

name: StandardDateFilterDuration
description:
Contains information about each standard date filter—also
      referred to as a relative date filter. It contains the API name and display label of the
      standard date filter duration as well as the start and end dates.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the date filter.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description:
Returns the display name of the date filter. Possible values are
      relative date filters—like Current FY and Current FQ—and custom date filters.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the date filter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description:
Returns the API name of the date filter. Possible values are relative
      date filters—like THIS_FISCAL_YEAR and NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER—and custom date filters.

name: StandardDateFilterDurationGroup
description:
Contains information about the standard date filter groupings, such as
      the grouping display label and all standard date filters that fall under the grouping.
      Groupings include Calendar Year, Calendar Quarter, Calendar
        Month, Calendar Week, Fiscal Year, Fiscal
        Quarter, Day, and custom values based on
      user-defined date ranges.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description:
Returns the display label for the standard date filter
    grouping.

methods.name: getStandardDateFilterDurations
methods.description: Returns the standard date filter groupings.

name: RevSignaling Namespace
description:
The RevSignaling namespace provides classes to
        extend the standard procedure plan implementation through custom logic. A procedure plan
        helps you set up your procedures, configure the procedure execution settings, and relate
        them to a context definition in one centralized location based on your
        requirements.

name: RevSalesTrxn Namespace
description:
The RevSalesTrxn namespace provides classes and

        and configuration.

methods.description:
For fields of type Double, returns the maximum number of
digits that can be stored, including all numbers to the left and to
the right of the decimal point (but excluding the decimal point character).

methods.description:
Returns the name of the custom field on the parent standard or
      custom object whose values are matched against the values of the child external object's
      indirect lookup relationship field. The match is done to determine which records are related
      to each other.

methods.name: getReferenceTo
methods.description:
Returns a list of Schema.sObjectType objects for the parent
objects of this field. If the isNamePointing method returns true, there
is more than one entry in the list, otherwise there is only one.

methods.name: getRelationshipName
methods.description: Returns the name of the child-to-parent relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipOrder
methods.description:
Returns 0 if the field is the primary relationship field or 1 if the field is the
            secondary relationship field.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description:
For fields of type Double, returns the number of digits to the right of the decimal
    point.

methods.name: getSOAPType
methods.description:
Returns one of the SoapType enum values, depending on the
type of field.

methods.name: getSObjectField
methods.description: Returns the token for this field.

methods.name: getSObjectType
methods.description: Returns the Salesforce object type from which this field originates.

methods.name: getType
methods.description:
Returns one of the DisplayType enum values, depending on
the type of field.

methods.name: isAccessible
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current user can see this field, false otherwise.

methods.name: isAiPredictionField
methods.description:
Returns true if
  the current field is enabled to display Einstein prediction data, false otherwise.

methods.name: isAutoNumber
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is an Auto Number field, false otherwise.

methods.name: isCalculated
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is a custom formula field, false otherwise. Note that custom formula fields are always
read-only.

methods.name: isCascadeDelete
methods.description:
Returns true if
the child object is deleted when the parent object is deleted, false otherwise.

methods.name: isCaseSensitive
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is case sensitive, false otherwise.

methods.name: isCreateable
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field can be created by the current user, false otherwise.

methods.name: isCustom
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is a custom field, false if it is a standard field, such as Name.

methods.name: isDefaultedOnCreate
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field receives a default value when created, false otherwise.

methods.name: isDependentPicklist
methods.description:
Returns true if
the picklist is a dependent picklist, false otherwise.

methods.name: isDeprecatedAndHidden
methods.description: Reserved for future use.

methods.name: isEncrypted
methods.description:
Returns true if the field is encrypted with
  Shield Platform Encryption, false otherwise.

methods.name: isExternalID
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is used as an external ID, false otherwise.

methods.name: isFilterable
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field can be used as part of the filter criteria of a WHERE statement, false otherwise.

methods.name: isFormulaTreatNullNumberAsZero
methods.description: Returns true if null is treated as zero in a formula field, false otherwise.

methods.name: isGroupable
methods.description:
Returns true if the field can be included in
  the GROUP BY clause of a SOQL query, false otherwise. This method is only available for Apex classes
  and triggers saved using API version 18.0 and higher.

methods.name: isHtmlFormatted
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field has been formatted for HTML and should be encoded for display
in HTML, false otherwise.
One example of a field that returns true for this method is a hyperlink custom formula field.
Another example is a custom formula field that has an IMAGE text function.

methods.name: isIdLookup
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field can be used to specify a record in an upsert method, false otherwise.

methods.name: isNameField
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is a name field, false otherwise.

methods.name: isNamePointing
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field can have multiple types of objects as parents. For example,
a task can have both the Contact/Lead ID (WhoId) field and the Opportunity/Account
ID (WhatId) field
return true for this method.
because either of those objects can be the parent of a particular
task record. This method returns false otherwise.

methods.name: isNillable
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is nillable, false otherwise. A nillable field can have empty content. A non-nillable
field must have a value for the object to be created or saved.

methods.name: isPermissionable
methods.description:
Returns true if
field permissions can be specified for the field, false otherwise.

methods.name: isRestrictedDelete
methods.description:
Returns true if
the parent object can't be deleted because it is referenced by a child
object, false otherwise.

methods.name: isRestrictedPicklist
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field is a restricted picklist, false otherwise

methods.name: isSearchPrefilterable
methods.description:
Returns true if a foreign
   key can be included in prefiltering when used in a SOSL WHERE clause, false
  otherwise.

methods.name: isSortable
methods.description:
Returns true if
a query can sort on the field, false otherwise

methods.name: isUnique
methods.description:
Returns true if
the value for the field must be unique, false otherwise

methods.name: isUpdateable
methods.description:
Returns true if
the field can be edited by the current user, or child records in a
master-detail relationship field on a custom object can be reparented
to different parent records; false otherwise.

methods.name: isWriteRequiresMasterRead
methods.description:
Returns true if
writing to the detail object requires read sharing instead of read/write
sharing of the parent.

name: Search Namespace
description:
The Search namespace provides classes for
        getting search results and suggestion results.

name: KnowledgeSuggestionFilter
description:
Filter settings that narrow the results from a call to System.Search.suggest(searchQuery, sObjectType, options)
      when the SOSL search query contains a KnowledgeArticleVersion object.

methods.name: addArticleType
methods.description:
Adds a filter that narrows suggestion results to display the specified
      article type. This filter is optional.

methods.name: addDataCategory
methods.signature:
public void addDataCategory(String dataCategoryGroupName, String
          dataCategoryName)
methods.description:
Adds a filter that narrows suggestion results to display articles in
      the specified data category. This filter is optional.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description:
Specifies the article topic to return. This filter is
    optional.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description:
Sets a channel to narrow the suggestion results to articles in the
      specified channel. This filter is optional.

methods.name: setDataCategories
methods.description:
Adds filters that narrow suggestion results to display articles in the
      specified data categories. Use this method to set multiple data category group and name pairs
      in one call. This filter is optional.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description:
Sets a language to narrow the suggestion results to display articles
      in that language. This filter value is required in calls to System.Search.suggest(String, String, Search.SuggestionOption).

methods.name: setPublishStatus
methods.description:
Sets a publish status to narrow the suggestion results to display
      articles with that status. This filter value is required in calls to System.Search.suggest(String, String,
        Search.SuggestionOption).

methods.name: setValidationStatus
methods.description:
Sets a validation status to narrow the suggestion results to display
      articles with that status. This filter is optional.

name: QuestionSuggestionFilter
description:
The Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter class filters results from a call to System.Search.suggest(searchQuery, sObjectType, options)
      when the SOSL searchQuery  contains a FeedItem object.

methods.name: addGroupId
methods.description:
Adds a filter to display questions associated with the single
      specified group whose ID is passed in as an argument. This filter is
    optional.

methods.name: addNetworkId
methods.description:
Adds a filter to display questions associated with the single
      specified network whose ID is passed in as an argument. This filter is
    optional.

methods.name: addUserId
methods.description:
Adds a filter to display questions belonging to the single specified
      user whose ID is passed in as an argument. This filter is optional.

methods.name: setGroupIds
methods.description:
Sets a new list of groups to replace the current list of groups where
      the group IDs are passed in as an argument. This filter is optional.

methods.name: setNetworkIds
methods.description:
Sets a new list of networks to replace the current list of networks
            where the network IDs are passed in as an argument. This filter is
        optional.

methods.name: setTopicId
methods.description:
Sets a filter to display questions associated with the single
      specified topic whose ID is passed in as an argument. This filter is
    optional.

methods.name: setUserIds
methods.description:
Sets a new list of users to replace the current list of users where
            the users IDs are passed in as an argument. This filter is optional.

name: QueryHandle

methods.name: create
methods.signature: public static sfsqlquery.QueryHandle create(String queryId, String dataspace)
methods.description: Creates a QueryHandle from a previously submitted query ID and data space name. Use this method to resume fetching results for a query that was submitted in an earlier transaction.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of this QueryHandle.

methods.description: Sets the row offset at which to begin fetching results and returns the same QueryHandle instance for method chaining. Use this when resuming a query to skip rows that were already processed.

methods.name: withWorkloadName

name: Row
description: Wraps a single Data 360 SQL query result row and provides typed accessor methods for retrieving column values by name or by 0-based index. Row instances are produced by SqlRowIterator and SqlQueueable; you don't construct Row objects directly during normal usage.

methods.name: Row
methods.description: Creates a Row from a raw API row and column metadata. In normal usage you don't construct Row objects directly — they're produced by SqlRowIterator and SqlQueueable.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a Boolean. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a Boolean. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the 0-based index of the specified column name in the result set. Use this to look up an index once and then access multiple rows efficiently using index-based getters. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column names are repeated in the table.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a Date. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a Date. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a Datetime. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a Datetime. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a Decimal. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a Decimal. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a Double. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a Double. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as an Integer. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as an Integer. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a List<Object>. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a List<Object>. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as a Long. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as a Long. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Returns the value of the column at the specified 0-based index as an Object. Use this when the column type is unknown or when you need the raw untyped value. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified column as an Object. Use this when the column type is unknown or when you need the raw untyped value. Returns null if the column value is null. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the column name is not found.

name: SqlQueueable
description: Abstract base class for executing long-running Data 360 SQL queries asynchronously in chained Queueable jobs. Implements Queueable and Database.AllowsCallouts. Create a concrete subclass that implements processDataChunk() to process each page of results and chainNextJob() to enqueue the next job when more data remains.

methods.name: SqlQueueable
methods.description: Creates a SqlQueueable subclass instance that resumes an in-progress query from a saved QueryHandle. Use this constructor in chainNextJob() to continue processing the next page.

methods.name: SqlQueueable
methods.description: Creates a SqlQueueable subclass instance from a SqlStatement to start a new query. Pass the constructed job to System.enqueueJob() to begin execution.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current query. When called inside processDataChunk(), the framework automatically skips chainNextJob(), stopping further job chaining.

methods.name: chainNextJob
methods.description: Abstract method called by the framework when more pages remain. Override this in your concrete subclass to enqueue the next job, passing the provided QueryHandle to the next job's constructor.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Returns the ordered list of column names from the current data chunk. Call this inside processDataChunk().

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the column metadata for the current data chunk, including column names and data types. Call this inside processDataChunk().

methods.name: getPageOutput
methods.description: Returns the raw ConnectApi.QuerySqlPageOutput for the current page. Use this inside processDataChunk() when you need direct access to the underlying API response instead of Row objects.

methods.name: getQueryId
methods.description: Returns the server-assigned ID for this query. Save this value to resume the query in a later job using QueryHandle.create().

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns the rows in the current data chunk as an iterable of Row objects. Call this inside processDataChunk() to iterate over the page with typed accessor methods.

methods.name: processDataChunk
methods.description: Abstract method called by the framework with each page of query results. Override this in your concrete subclass to process the data chunk. Use getRows() or getPageOutput() to access the current page's data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this SqlQueueable.

name: SqlRowIterator
description: Synchronous iterator for executing Data 360 SQL queries and retrieving results row-by-row within the current transaction. Implements Iterator<Row> and Iterable<Row> for use in both for-each and while loops. The iterator is single-use; once all rows are consumed, iterating again does not restart from the beginning.

methods.name: SqlRowIterator
methods.description: Creates a SqlRowIterator that resumes fetching results for a previously submitted query.

methods.name: SqlRowIterator
methods.description: Creates a SqlRowIterator from a SqlStatement. Equivalent to calling execute() on the statement.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the query and releases server-side resources. Any subsequent call to hasNext() returns false.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Returns the ordered list of column names from the query result set. Available after the first page of results is fetched.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the column metadata for the query result set, including column names and their data types. Available after the first page of results is fetched.

methods.name: getQueryId
methods.description: Returns the server-assigned ID for this query. Triggers query submission if the query hasn't started yet. Save this value to resume the query in a later transaction using QueryHandle.create().

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Returns true if more rows remain to be fetched, or false if all rows have been consumed or the query was canceled.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns this SqlRowIterator as an Iterator, enabling use in for-each loops.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next Row in the result set. Throws NoSuchElementException if hasNext() is false.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this SqlRowIterator.

name: SqlStatement
description: Encapsulates the inputs required to execute a Data 360 SQL query against a data space. Build a statement from a raw SQL string or a pre-built ConnectApi.QuerySqlInput object, and then execute synchronously with SqlRowIterator or pass it to a SqlQueueable subclass for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: create
methods.signature: public static sfsqlquery.SqlStatement create(ConnectApi.QuerySqlInput query, String dataspace)
methods.description: Creates a SqlStatement from a pre-built ConnectApi.QuerySqlInput object. Use this method when you need to configure query properties beyond a SQL string, such as parameterized queries, a server-side row limit, or custom query settings.

methods.name: create
methods.signature: public static sfsqlquery.SqlStatement create(String sql, String dataspace)
methods.description: Creates a SqlStatement from a raw SQL string and a data space name.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Returns a synchronous SqlRowIterator built from this statement. Equivalent to new sfsqlquery.SqlRowIterator(statement). The query isn't submitted until iteration begins.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this SqlStatement.

methods.name: withWorkloadName
methods.description: Sets the workload name to send with the query and returns the same SqlStatement instance for method chaining. If not set, the framework uses dcsql_row_iterator_workload for iterators or dcsql_queueable_workload for queueables.

name: SqlTester
description: Test utility for mocking Data 360 SQL query API responses in Apex tests. The framework automatically detects the test context via Test.isRunningTest() and returns mocked responses when configured. Call clearMocks() before each test to ensure a clean state.

methods.name: clearMocks
methods.description: Resets all mock state, including metadata, rows, and page queues. Call this at the start of each test method to ensure a clean state.

methods.name: enqueueMockRows
methods.description: Adds a page of mock rows to the result queue. Call this multiple times to simulate multi-page results. Each call adds one page; pages are returned in the order they were enqueued.

methods.name: isRunningTest
methods.description: Returns true if the framework is currently executing within a test context. The framework calls this internally to decide whether to return mocked responses.

methods.name: setMockMetadata
methods.description: Sets the mock column metadata that the framework returns for all queries in the current test. Call this before executing any query.

methods.name: setMockRows
methods.description: Sets a single page of mock rows to return for the query. Use enqueueMockRows() instead when simulating multi-page results.

description:
Custom metadata types are customizable, deployable, packageable, and
         upgradeable application metadata. All custom metadata is exposed in the application cache,
         which allows access without repeated queries to the database. The metadata is then
         available for formula fields, validation rules, flows, Apex, and SOAP API. All methods are
         static.

description:
Custom settings are similar to custom objects and enable application developers to
        create custom sets of data, as well as create and associate custom data for an organization,
        profile, or specific user. All custom settings data is exposed in the application cache,
        which enables efficient access without the cost of repeated queries to the database. This
        data is then available for formula fields, validation rules, flows, Apex, and the SOAP
        API.
