name: Domain
description:
Represents an existing domain hosted by Salesforce that serves the org
      or its content. Contains methods to obtain information about these domains, such as the domain
      type, My Domain name, and sandbox name.

methods.name: getDomainType
methods.description:
Returns the domain’s type, such as CONTENT_DOMAIN, EXPERIENCE_CLOUD_SITES_DOMAIN,
      or LIGHTNING_DOMAIN.

methods.name: getMyDomainName
methods.description: Returns the domain’s My Domain name.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description:
For a domain that includes the package name, such as a Lightning
      Component domain or Visualforce page domain, returns the package name. For a domain that
      doesn’t contain a package name, this method returns null.

methods.name: getSandboxName
methods.description:
For a sandbox org domain, returns the sandbox name. For a production
      org domain, returns null.

methods.name: getSitesSubdomainName
methods.description:
For a system-managed Experience Cloud site domain or Salesforce Site
      domain, returns the sites subdomain name. If enhanced domains are enabled, this method always returns null. When enhanced domains are enabled, the org’s My Domain name
      is the subdomain for the system-managed domains for Experience Cloud sites and Salesforce
      Sites domains.

name: DomainCreator
description:
Use the DomainCreator class to return a hostname specific to the org.
      For example, get the org’s Visualforce hostname. Values are returned as a hostname, such as
        MyDomainName.lightning.force.com.

methods.name: getContentHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname for content stored in the org, such as
      files.

methods.name: getExperienceCloudSitesBuilderHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname to access Experience Builder for the org’s
      Experience Cloud sites.

methods.name: getExperienceCloudSitesHostname
methods.description:
Returns the system-managed hostname for the org’s Experience Cloud
      sites, such as ExperienceCloudSitesSubdomainName.force.com. If Digital
      Experiences aren’t enabled, this method throws an InvalidParameterValueException.

methods.name: getExperienceCloudSitesLivePreviewHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname to access Experience Builder Live Preview for the
      org’s Experience Cloud sites.

methods.name: getExperienceCloudSitesPreviewHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname to access Experience Builder Preview for the
      org’s Experience Cloud sites.

methods.name: getLightningContainerComponentHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname for the org’s Lightning Container
      Components.

methods.name: getLightningHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the org’s Lightning pages.

methods.name: getOrgMyDomainHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname for the org’s My Domain login
    domain.

methods.name: getSalesforceSitesHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname for the org’s Salesforce Sites. If Salesforce
      Sites aren’t enabled, this method throws an InvalidParameterValueException.

methods.name: getSetupHostname
methods.description:
Returns the hostname for the org’s setup domain, which hosts Setup
      pages in Salesforce.

methods.name: getVisualforceHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the org’s Visualforce pages.

An exception denotes an error that disrupts the normal flow of code execution. You
        can use Apex built-in exceptions or create custom exceptions. All exceptions have common

name: Iterator
description:
The Iterator interface enables you to iterate through a collection, such as a set or a
      list, in script. An instance of this interface allows the traversal of a collection of
      objects. This interface has no built-in implementations -- it's implemented by a
      generic Iterator (Iterator<T>) type that List/Set's own iterator() method returns, or
      by a custom class that implements Iterator<T> itself.

methods.description: Returns true if there's another element in the collection being iterated over.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the collection.

    test

    expected request payload, then triggers the mocked external service’s asynchronous callback
    response.

methods.description: Sends the HTTP request back as an external service asynchronous response.

Use the methods in the System.FeatureManagement class to check and modify the values of feature
      parameters, and to show or hide custom objects and custom permissions in your subscribers’
      orgs.

methods.signature: public static void changeProtection(String apiName, String typeApiName, String protection)
methods.description:
Hides or reveals custom permissions, or reveals custom objects, in
      your subscriber’s org.

methods.description:
Checks the value__c value of the
      FeatureParameterBoolean__c record for a feature parameter in your
    subscriber’s org. You set the record’s value using setPackageBooleanValue(apiName, value).

methods.name: checkPackageDateValue
methods.description:
Checks the value__c value of the
      FeatureParameterDate__c record for a feature parameter in your
    subscriber’s org. You can set the record’s value using setPackageDateValue(apiName, value).

Checks the value__c value of the
      FeatureParameterInteger__c record for a feature parameter in your
    subscriber’s org. You can set the record’s value using setPackageIntegerValue(apiName, value).

          Boolean value)

Sets the value__c value of the
      FeatureParameterBoolean__c record for a subscriber-to-LMO feature
    parameter in your subscriber’s org. You can check the record’s value using checkPackageBooleanValue(apiName).

          value)

Sets the value__c value of the
      FeatureParameterDate__c record for a subscriber-to-LMO feature parameter
    in your subscriber’s org. You can check the record’s value using checkPackageDateValue(apiName).

name: Finalizer
description:
Use this interface to attach actions that are executed at the end of asynchronous
    Queueable job executions. A specific use case is to design recovery actions when a Queueable job
    fails.

methods.name: execute
methods.description:
The execute method is called on the provided
      Finalizer instance for every enqueued job that has an
    attached finalizer. Within the execute method, you can
    define the actions to be taken at the end of the Queueable job.

name: FinalizerContext
description:
Represents the parameter type of the execute
    method in a class that implements the Finalizer interface. This interface is implemented
    internally by Apex. The System.FinalizerContext interface contains four methods: getAsyncApexJobId, getRequestId, getResult, and getException. An instance of System.FinalizerContext is injected by the Apex runtime engine as an argument to the
      Finalizer.execute method.

methods.name: getAsyncApexJobId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Queueable job for which this finalizer is defined.

methods.name: getException
methods.description: Returns the exception with which the Queueable job failed when getResult is UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION, null otherwise.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description:
Returns the request ID that can be correlated with Event Monitoring logs. To correlate
    the request with the AsyncApexJob table, use the getAsyncApexJobId method instead. The Queueable job and the Finalizer execution
    share the same request ID.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description:
Returns
    the System.ParentJobResult enum,
    which represents the result of the parent asynchronous Apex Queueable job to
    which the finalizer is attached. The enum takes these values: SUCCESS, UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION.

name: FlexQueue
description:
Contains methods that reorder batch jobs in the Apex flex
      queue.

methods.name: moveAfterJob
methods.signature:
public static Boolean moveAfterJob(Id jobToMoveId, Id
          jobInQueueId)
methods.description:
Moves the job with the ID jobToMoveId immediately
      after the job with the ID jobInQueueId in the flex queue. You can move
        jobToMoveId forward or backward in the queue. If either job isn’t in the
      queue, it throws an element-not-found exception. Returns true if the job is moved, or false if
        jobToMoveId is already immediately after jobInQueueId,
      so no change is made.

methods.name: moveBeforeJob
methods.signature:
public static Boolean moveBeforeJob(Id jobToMoveId, Id
          jobInQueueId)
methods.description:
Moves the job with the ID jobToMoveId immediately
      before the job with the ID jobInQueueId in the flex queue. You can move
        jobToMoveId forward or backward in the queue. If either job isn’t in the
      queue, it throws an element-not-found exception. Returns true if the job is moved, or false if
        jobToMoveId is already immediately before
      jobInQueueId, so no change is made.

methods.name: moveJobToEnd
methods.description:
Moves the specified job the end of the flex queue, to index position
        (size - 1). All jobs after the job’s starting
      position move one spot forward. If the job isn’t in the queue, it throws an element-not-found
      exception. Returns true if the job is moved, or
        false if the job is already at the end of the queue,
      so no change is made.

methods.name: moveJobToFront
methods.description:
Moves the specified job to the front of the flex queue, to index
      position 0. All other jobs move back one spot. If the
      job isn’t in the queue, it throws an element-not-found exception. Returns true if the job is moved, or false if the job is already at the front of the queue, so no change is
    made.

name: List
description: Contains methods for the List collection type.

methods.name: List<T>
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the List class. A list can hold elements of any data type T.

methods.name: List<T>
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the List class by copying the elements from the specified list.
T is the data type of the elements in both lists and can be any data
type.

methods.name: List<T>
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the List class by copying the elements from the specified set.
T is the data type of the elements in the set and list and can be
any data type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the list.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: public Void add(Integer index, Object listElement)
methods.description:
Inserts an element into the list at the specified index position and shifts all
    subsequent elements one index position to the right.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description:
Adds all of the elements in the specified list to the list
that calls the method. Both lists must be of the same type.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description:
Add all of the elements in specified set to the  list that
calls the method. The set and the list must be of the same type.

methods.name: clear
methods.description:
Removes all elements from a list, consequently setting
the  list's length to zero.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Makes a duplicate copy of a list.

methods.name: contains
methods.description:
Returns true if the list contains the specified
  element.

methods.name: deepClone
methods.signature:
public List<Object> deepClone(Boolean preserveId,
                    Boolean preserveReadonlyTimestamps, Boolean preserveAutonumber)
methods.description:
Makes a duplicate copy of a list of sObject records, including the sObject records
        themselves.

methods.name: equals
methods.description:
Compares this list with the specified list and returns true if both lists are equal; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the list element stored at the specified index.

methods.name: getSObjectType
methods.description:
Returns the token of the sObject type that makes up a list
of sObjects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description:
Returns the hashcode corresponding to this list and its
contents.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description:
Returns the index of the first occurrence of the specified element in this list. If
    this list does not contain the element, returns -1.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the list has zero elements.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an instance of an iterator for this list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description:
Removes the list element stored at the specified index,
returning the element that was removed.

methods.name: set
methods.signature: public Void set(Integer index, Object listElement)
methods.description: Sets the specified value for the element at the given index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the items in the list in ascending order.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the list.

name: Location
description:
Contains methods for accessing the component fields of geolocation
      compound fields.

methods.name: getDistance
methods.signature:
public Double getDistance(Location toLocation, String
          unit)
methods.description:
Calculates the distance between this location and the specified
      location, using an approximation of the haversine formula and the specified
    unit.

methods.name: getDistance
methods.signature:
public static Double getDistance(Location
                    firstLocation, Location secondLocation, String unit)
methods.description:
Calculates the distance between the two specified locations, using
            an approximation of the haversine formula and the specified unit.

methods.name: getLatitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude field of this location.

methods.name: getLongitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude field of this location.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.signature:
public static Location newInstance(Decimal latitude, Decimal
          longitude)
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Location class, with the specified latitude and longitude.

name: LoggingLevel
description: Specifies the logging level for the System.debug method.

properties.name: NONE
properties.description: No logging.

properties.name: ERROR
properties.description: Error and exception logging.

properties.name: WARN
properties.description: Warning logging.

properties.name: INFO
properties.description: Informational logging.

properties.name: DEBUG
properties.description: User-specified debug logging.

properties.name: FINE
properties.description: High level of logging.

properties.name: FINER
properties.description: Higher level of logging than FINE.

properties.name: FINEST
properties.description: Highest level of logging.

name: Long
description: Contains methods for the Long primitive data type.

methods.name: format
methods.description:
Returns the String format for this Long using the locale
of the context user.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the Integer value for this Long.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description:
Returns a Long that contains the value of the specified
String. As in Java, the string is interpreted as representing a signed
decimal Long.

name: Map
description: Contains methods for the Map collection type.

methods.name: Map<T1,T2>
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the Map class. T1 is the data type of the keys and T2 is the
data type of the values.

methods.name: Map<T1,T2>
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the Map class and initializes it by copying the entries from
the specified map. T1 is the data type of the keys and T2 is the data
type of the values.

methods.name: Map<ID,sObject>
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the Map class and populates it with the passed-in list of sObject
records. The keys are populated with the sObject IDs and the values
are the sObjects.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all of the key-value mappings from the map.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Makes a duplicate copy of the map.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description:
Returns true if the map contains a mapping for
  the specified key.

methods.name: deepClone
methods.description:
Makes a duplicate copy of a map, including sObject records
if this is a map with sObject record values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description:
Compares this map with the specified map and returns true if both maps are equal; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the value to which the specified key is mapped, or null if the map contains no value for this key.

methods.name: getSObjectType
methods.description:
Returns the token of the sObject type that makes up the
map values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hashcode corresponding to this map.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the map has zero key-value pairs.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set that contains all of the keys in the map.

methods.name: put
methods.signature: public Object put(Object key, Object value)
methods.description: Associates the specified value with the specified key in the map.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description:
Copies all of the mappings from the specified map to the
original map.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description:
Adds the list of sObject records to a map declared as Map<ID,
sObject> or Map<String, sObject>.

methods.name: remove
methods.description:
Removes the mapping for the specified key from the map, if present, and returns the
  corresponding value.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a list that contains all the values in the map.

name: Matcher
description:
Matchers use Patterns to perform match operations on a
character string.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the position after the last matched character.

methods.name: end
methods.description:
Returns the position after the last character of the subsequence
captured by the group index during the previous match operation. If
the match was successful but the group itself did not match anything,
this method returns -1.

methods.name: find
methods.description:
Attempts to find the next subsequence
of the input sequence that matches the pattern. This method returns
true if a subsequence of the input sequence matches this Matcher object's
pattern.

methods.name: find
methods.description:
Resets the Matcher object and then tries to find the next
subsequence of the input sequence that matches the pattern. This method
returns true if a subsequence
of the input sequence matches this Matcher object's pattern.

methods.name: group
methods.description:
Returns the input subsequence returned by the previous
match.

methods.name: group
methods.description:
Returns the input subsequence captured by the specified
group index during the previous match operation. If the match was
successful but the specified group failed to match any part of the
input sequence, null is returned.

methods.name: groupCount
methods.description:
Returns the number of capturing groups in this Matching
object's pattern. Group zero denotes the entire pattern and is not
included in this count.

methods.name: hasAnchoringBounds
methods.description:
Returns true if the Matcher object has anchoring bounds,
false otherwise. By default, a Matcher
object uses anchoring bounds regions.

methods.name: hasTransparentBounds
methods.description:
Returns true if the Matcher object has transparent bounds,
false if it uses opaque bounds. By default,
a Matcher object uses opaque region boundaries.

methods.name: hitEnd
methods.description:
Returns true if the end of input was found by the search
engine in the last match operation performed by this Matcher object.
When this method returns true, it is possible that more input would
have changed the result of the last search.

methods.name: lookingAt
methods.description:
Attempts to match the input sequence, starting at the beginning
of the region, against the pattern.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Attempts to match the entire region against the pattern.

methods.name: pattern
methods.description:
Returns the Pattern object from which this Matcher object
was created.

methods.name: quoteReplacement
methods.description:
Returns a literal replacement
string for the specified string inputString. The characters in the returned string match the sequence of characters
in inputString.

methods.name: region
methods.signature:
public Matcher object region(Integer start,
Integer end)
methods.description:
Sets the limits of this Matcher object's region. The region
is the part of the input sequence that is searched to find a match.

methods.name: regionEnd
methods.description:
Returns the end index (exclusive) of this Matcher object's
region.

methods.name: regionStart
methods.description:
Returns the start index (inclusive) of this Matcher object's
region.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description:
Replaces every subsequence of the input sequence that matches
the pattern with the replacement string.

methods.name: replaceFirst
methods.description:
Replaces the first subsequence of the input sequence that
matches the pattern with the replacement string.

methods.name: requireEnd
methods.description:
Returns true if more input could change a positive match
into a negative one.

methods.name: reset
methods.description:
Resets this Matcher object. Resetting a Matcher object discards
all of its explicit state information.

methods.name: reset
methods.description:
Resets this Matcher object with the new input sequence.
Resetting a Matcher object discards all of its explicit state information.

methods.name: start
methods.description:
Returns the start index of the first character of the previous
match.

methods.name: start
methods.description:
Returns the start index of the subsequence captured by
the group specified by the group index during the previous match operation.
Captured groups are indexed from left to right, starting at one. Group
zero denotes the entire pattern, so the expression m.start(0) is equivalent to m.start().

methods.name: useAnchoringBounds
methods.description:
Sets the anchoring bounds of the region for the Matcher
object. By default, a Matcher object uses anchoring bounds regions.

methods.name: usePattern
methods.description:
Changes the Pattern object that the Matcher object uses
to find matches. This method causes the Matcher object to lose information
about the groups of the last match that occurred. The Matcher object's
position in the input is maintained.

methods.name: useTransparentBounds
methods.description:
Sets the transparency bounds for this Matcher object. By
default, a Matcher object uses anchoring bounds regions.

name: Math
description: Contains methods for mathematical operations.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the specified Decimal.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the specified Double.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the specified Integer.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the specified Long.

methods.name: acos
methods.description:
Returns the arc cosine of an angle, in the range of 0.0
through pi.

methods.name: acos
methods.description:
Returns the arc cosine of an angle, in the range of 0.0
through pi.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Returns the arc sine of an angle, in the range of -pi/2 through pi/2.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Returns the arc sine of an angle, in the range of -pi/2 through pi/2.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Returns the arc tangent of an angle, in the range of -pi/2 through pi/2.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Returns the arc tangent of an angle, in the range of -pi/2 through pi/2.

methods.name: atan2
methods.signature:
public static Decimal atan2(Decimal xCoordinate, Decimal
     yCoordinate)
methods.description:
Converts rectangular coordinates (xCoordinate and
   yCoordinate) to polar (r and theta).
  This method computes the phase theta by computing an arc tangent of
   xCoordinate/yCoordinate in the range of -pi to
   pi.

methods.name: atan2
methods.signature:
public static Double atan2(Double xCoordinate, Double
     yCoordinate)
methods.description:
Converts rectangular coordinates (xCoordinate and
   yCoordinate) to polar (r and theta).
  This method computes the phase theta by computing an arc tangent of
   xCoordinate/yCoordinate in the range of -pi to
   pi.

methods.name: cbrt
methods.description:
Returns the cube root of the specified Decimal. The cube
root of a negative value is the negative of the cube root of that
value's magnitude.

methods.name: cbrt
methods.description:
Returns the cube root of the specified Double. The cube
root of a negative value is the negative of the cube root of that
value's magnitude.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description:
Returns the smallest (closest to negative infinity) Decimal
that is not less than the argument and is equal to a mathematical
integer.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description:
Returns the smallest (closest to negative infinity) Double
that is not less than the argument and is equal to a mathematical
integer.

methods.name: cos
methods.description:
Returns the trigonometric cosine of the angle specified by
         decimalAngle.

methods.name: cos
methods.description:
Returns the trigonometric cosine of the angle specified by
      doubleAngle.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description:
Returns the hyperbolic cosine of decimalAngle. The hyperbolic cosine
  of d is defined to be (ex + e-x)/2 where
   e is Euler's number.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description:
Returns the hyperbolic cosine of doubleAngle. The hyperbolic cosine of
   d is defined to be (ex + e-x)/2 where
   e is Euler's number.

methods.name: exp
methods.description:
Returns Euler's number e raised to the power of
the specified Decimal.

methods.name: exp
methods.description:
Returns Euler's number e raised to the power of
the specified Double.

methods.name: floor
methods.description:
Returns the largest (closest to positive infinity) Decimal
that is not greater than the argument and is equal to a mathematical
integer.

methods.name: floor
methods.description:
Returns the largest (closest to positive infinity) Double
that is not greater than the argument and is equal to a mathematical
integer.

methods.name: log
methods.description:
Returns the natural logarithm (base e) of the specified
Decimal.

methods.name: log
methods.description:
Returns the natural logarithm (base e) of the specified
Double.

methods.name: log10
methods.description:
Returns the logarithm (base 10) of the specified
Decimal.

methods.name: log10
methods.description:
Returns the logarithm (base 10) of the specified
Double.

methods.name: max
methods.signature:
public static Decimal max(Decimal decimalValue1, Decimal
     decimalValue2)
methods.description: Returns the larger of the two specified Decimals.

methods.name: max
methods.signature:
public static Double max(Double doubleValue1, Double
     doubleValue2)
methods.description: Returns the larger of the two specified Doubles.

methods.name: max
methods.signature:
public static Integer max(Integer integerValue1, Integer
     integerValue2)
methods.description: Returns the larger of the two specified Integers.

methods.name: max
methods.signature:
public static Long max(Long longValue1, Long
    longValue2)
methods.description: Returns the larger of the two specified Longs.

methods.name: min
methods.signature:
public static Decimal min(Decimal decimalValue1, Decimal
     decimalValue2)
methods.description: Returns the smaller of the two specified Decimals.

methods.name: min
methods.signature:
public static Double min(Double doubleValue1, Double
     doubleValue2)
methods.description: Returns the smaller of the two specified Doubles.

methods.name: min
methods.signature:
public static Integer min(Integer integerValue1, Integer
     integerValue2)
methods.description: Returns the smaller of the two specified Integers.

methods.name: min
methods.signature:
public static Long min(Long longValue1, Long
    longValue2)
methods.description: Returns the smaller of the two specified Longs.

methods.name: mod
methods.signature:
public static Integer mod(Integer integerValue1, Integer
     integerValue2)
methods.description:
Returns the remainder of integerValue1 divided by
   integerValue2.

methods.name: mod
methods.signature:
public static Long mod(Long longValue1, Long
                    longValue2)
methods.description:
Returns the remainder of longValue1 divided by
            longValue2.

methods.name: pow
methods.signature:
public static Double pow(Double doubleValue, Double
               exponent)
methods.description:
Returns the value of the first Double raised to the power of
      exponent.

methods.name: random
methods.description:
Returns a positive Double that is greater than or equal
to 0.0 and less than 1.0.

methods.name: rint
methods.description:
Returns the value that is closest in value to decimalValue and is
  equal to a mathematical integer.

methods.name: rint
methods.description:
Returns the value that is closest in value to doubleValue and is equal
  to a mathematical integer.

methods.name: round
methods.description:
Do not use. This method is deprecated as of the Winter '08 release. Instead, use Math.roundToLong. Returns the closest Integer to the specified
  Double. If the result is less than -2,147,483,648 or greater than 2,147,483,647, Apex generates an
  error.

methods.name: round
methods.description:
Returns the rounded approximation of this Decimal. The number is rounded to zero decimal
    places using half-even rounding mode, that is, it rounds towards the “nearest
    neighbor” unless both neighbors are equidistant, in which case, this mode rounds towards
    the even neighbor. If the result is less than -2,147,483,648 or greater than 2,147,483,647, Apex
    generates an error.

methods.name: roundToLong
methods.description:
Returns the rounded approximation of this Decimal. The
number  is rounded to zero decimal places using half-even rounding
mode, that is, it rounds towards the “nearest neighbor”
unless both neighbors are equidistant, in which case, this mode rounds
towards the even neighbor.

methods.name: roundToLong
methods.description: Returns the closest Long to the specified Double.

methods.name: signum
methods.description:
Returns the signum function of the specified Decimal, which is 0 if
   decimalValue is 0, 1.0 if decimalValue is greater than 0,
  -1.0 if decimalValue is less than 0.

methods.name: signum
methods.description:
Returns the signum function of the specified Double, which is 0 if
   doubleValue is 0, 1.0 if doubleValue is greater than 0,
  -1.0 if doubleValue is less than 0.

methods.name: sin
methods.description:
Returns the trigonometric sine of the angle specified by
      decimalAngle.

methods.name: sin
methods.description:
Returns the trigonometric sine of the angle specified by
      doubleAngle.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description:
Returns the hyperbolic sine of decimalAngle. The hyperbolic sine of
   decimalAngle is defined to be (ex - e-x)/2
  where e is Euler's number.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description:
Returns the hyperbolic sine of doubleAngle. The hyperbolic sine of
   doubleAngle is defined to be (ex - e-x)/2
  where e is Euler's number.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description:
Returns the correctly rounded positive square root of
      decimalValue.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description:
Returns the correctly rounded positive square root of
      doubleValue.

methods.name: tan
methods.description:
Returns the trigonometric tangent of the angle specified by
         decimalAngle.

methods.name: tan
methods.description:
Returns the trigonometric tangent of the angle specified by
         doubleAngle.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description:
Returns the hyperbolic tangent of decimalAngle. The hyperbolic tangent
  of decimalAngle is defined to be (ex -
   e-x)/(ex + e-x) where e is Euler's
  number. In other words, it is equivalent to sinh(x)/cosinh(x). The absolute value of the exact tanh is always less than 1.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description:
Returns the hyperbolic tangent of doubleAngle. The hyperbolic tangent
  of doubleAngle is defined to be (ex -
   e-x)/(ex + e-x) where e is Euler's
  number. In other words, it is equivalent to sinh(x)/cosinh(x). The absolute value of the exact tanh is always less than 1.

properties.name: E
properties.description:
Returns the mathematical constant e, which is the base of
   natural logarithms.

properties.name: PI
properties.description:
Returns the mathematical constant pi, which is the ratio of
   the circumference of a circle to its diameter.

name: Messaging
description:
Contains messaging methods used when sending a single or
mass email.

methods.name: extractInboundEmail
methods.signature:
public static Messaging.InboundEmail
          extractInboundEmail(Object source, Boolean includeForwardedAttachments)
methods.description:
Use this method in your email service code to control how to parse
      and process forwarded or attached emails. Returns an instance of Messaging.InboundEmail from a stream of data that is in
      RFC822 format. The data stream can be a forwarded email in an attachment to an existing
      InboundEmail, or a stream from another source.

methods.name: reserveMassEmailCapacity
methods.description:
Reserves email capacity to send mass email to the specified number of email addresses,
  after the current transaction commits.

methods.name: reserveSingleEmailCapacity
methods.description:
Reserves email capacity to send single email to the specified number of email addresses,
  after the current transaction commits.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.signature:
public Messaging.SendEmailResult[] sendEmail(Messaging.Email[]
emails, Boolean allOrNothing)
methods.description:
Sends the list of emails instantiated with either SingleEmailMessage or MassEmailMessage and
    returns a list of SendEmailResult objects. When org preferences are set to save EmailMessage
    objects and a trigger is defined for EmailMessage objects, the trigger is fired for each SingleEmailMessage individually. The sendEmail method can be called 10 times per Apex transaction
    and each method invocation can include up to 100 "To", 25 "Cc", and 25 "Bcc" recipients.

methods.name: sendEmailMessage
methods.signature:
public Messaging.SendEmailResult[] sendEmailMessage(List<ID>
          emailMessageIds, Boolean allOrNothing)
methods.description:
Sends draft email messages as defined by the specified
      email message IDs and returns a list of SendEmailResult objects.

methods.name: renderEmailTemplate
methods.signature: public static List<Messaging.RenderEmailTemplateBodyResult> renderEmailTemplate(String whoId, String whatId, List<String> bodies)
methods.description:
Replaces merge fields in text bodies of email templates with values
      from Salesforce records.
      Returns an array of RenderEmailTemplateBodyResult
      objects, each of which corresponds to an element in the supplied array of text bodies. Each
        RenderEmailTemplateBodyResult provides a success or
      failure indication, along with either an error code or the rendered text.

methods.name: renderStoredEmailTemplate
methods.signature:
public static Messaging.SingleEmailMessage
          renderStoredEmailTemplate(String templateId, String whoId, String whatId)
methods.description:
Renders a text, custom, HTML, or Visualforce email template that
      exists in the database into an instance of Messaging.SingleEmailMessage. Includes all attachment content in the returned
      email message.

methods.name: renderStoredEmailTemplate
methods.signature:
public static Messaging.SingleEmailMessage
          renderStoredEmailTemplate(String templateId, String whoId, String whatId,
          Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption attachmentRetrievalOption)
methods.description:
Renders a text, custom, HTML, or Visualforce email template that
      exists in the database into an instance of Messaging.SingleEmailMessage. Provides options for including attachment metadata
      only, attachment metadata and content, or excluding attachments.

methods.name: renderStoredEmailTemplate
methods.signature:
public static Messaging.SingleEmailMessage
          renderStoredEmailTemplate(String templateId, String whoId, String whatId,
          Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption attachmentRetrievalOption, Boolean
          updateEmailTemplateUsage)
methods.description:
Renders a text, custom, HTML, or Visualforce email template that
      exists in the database into an instance of Messaging.SingleEmailMessage. Provides options for including attachment metadata
      only, attachment metadata and content, or excluding attachments.

Utility class used to specify a fake response using multiple
resources for testing HTTP callouts.

methods.name: setHeader

public Void setHeader(String headerName, String
headerValue)

Sets the specified header name and
value for the fake response.

String resourceName)

Sets the specified static resource corresponding to the

methods.name: setStatus

the response.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description:
Sets the specified HTTP status
code for the response.

name: Network
description: Manage Experience Cloud sites.

methods.name: Network
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the System.Network class.

methods.name: communitiesLanding
methods.description:
Returns a Page Reference to the default landing page for the Experience Cloud site. This
  is the first tab of the site.

methods.name: createExternalUserAsync
methods.signature: public static String createExternalUserAsync(SObject user, SObject contact, SObject account)
methods.description:
Asynchronously creates an Experience Cloud site user for the given
      account or contact and associates it with the site. This method processes requests in batches
      and then sends an email with login information to the user.

methods.name: createRecordAsync
methods.signature: public static String createRecordAsync(String processType, SObject mbObject)
methods.description:
Asynchronously creates case, lead, and custom object records. This
      method collects record creation requests and processes them in batches.

methods.name: forwardToAuthPage
methods.description:
Returns a Page Reference to the default login page. StartURL
is included as a query paremeter for where to redirect after a successful
login.

methods.name: getLoginUrl
methods.description:
Returns the absolute URL of the login page used by the
      Experience Cloud site.

methods.name: getLogoutUrl
methods.description:
Returns the absolute URL of the logout page used by the
      Experience Cloud site.

methods.name: getNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the user’s current Experience Cloud site.

methods.name: getSelfRegUrl
methods.description:
Returns the absolute URL of the self-registration page used
      by the Experience Cloud site.

methods.name: loadAllPackageDefaultNetworkDashboardSettings
methods.description:
Maps the dashboards from the Salesforce Communities Management package onto each Experience Cloud site’s unconfigured dashboard settings. Returns the
      number of settings it configures.

methods.name: loadAllPackageDefaultNetworkPulseSettings
methods.description:
Maps the Insights reports from the Salesforce Communities Management package onto each Experience Cloud site’s unconfigured Insights settings. Returns the
      number of settings it configures.

name: Object
description: Contains methods that are implemented by all Apex types.

methods.name: equals
methods.description:
Compares an object to the specified object and returns true if both are equal.
    Otherwise, returns false.

  references and links should use.

methods.name: getBaseCustomUrl
methods.description:
Returns a base URL for the current site that doesn’t use a force.com
        subdomain. The returned URL uses the same protocol (HTTP or HTTPS) as the current request if
        at least one non-Force.com custom URL that supports HTTPS exists on the site. The returned
        value never ends with a / character. If all the custom
        URLs in this site end in Force.com or this site has no custom URLs, then this returns an
        empty string. If the current request is not a site request, then this method returns an
        empty string. This method replaced getCustomWebAddress and includes the custom URL's path
        prefix..

methods.name: getBaseInsecureUrl
methods.description:
Deprecated. Returns a base URL for the current site that uses HTTP instead of HTTPS. The
    current request's domain is used. The returned value includes the path prefix and never ends
    with a / character. If the current request is not a site
    request, then this method returns an empty string.

methods.name: getBaseRequestUrl
methods.description:
Returns the base URL of the current site for the requested
URL. This isn't influenced by the referring page's URL. The returned
URL uses the same protocol (HTTP or HTTPS) as the current request.
The returned value includes the path prefix and never ends with a / character. If the current request is
not a site request, then this method returns an empty string.

methods.name: getBaseSecureUrl
methods.description:
Returns a base URL for the current site that uses HTTPS instead of HTTP. The current
  request's domain is preferred if it supports HTTPS. Domains that are not Force.com subdomains are
  preferred over Force.com subdomains. A Force.com subdomain, if associated with the site, is used
  if no other HTTPS domains exist in the current site. If no HTTPS custom URLs exist in the site,
  then this method returns an empty string. The returned value includes the path prefix and never
  ends with a / character. If the current request is not a site
  request, then this method returns an empty string.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description:
Returns the base URL of the current site that references and links should use. Note that
  this field may return the referring page's URL instead of the current request's URL. The returned
  value includes the path prefix and never ends with a /
  character. If the current request is not a site request, then this field returns an empty string.
  This field replaces getCurrentSiteUrl.

methods.name: getCustomWebAddress
methods.description: Deprecated. This method was replaced by getBaseCustomUrl() in API version 30.0.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns your Salesforce Sites based URL.

methods.name: getErrorDescription
methods.description:
Returns the error description for the current page if it’s a designated error
  page for the site and an error exists; otherwise, returns an empty string.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description:
Returns an error message for the current page if it’s a designated error page for
  the site and an error exists; otherwise, returns an empty string.

methods.name: getExperienceId
methods.description:
Returns the value of the experience ID (expid). This expid value comes
      from a cookie in the user’s web browser.

methods.name: getMasterLabel
methods.description:
Returns the value of the Master Label field for the current
site. If the current request is not a site request, then this field
returns null.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the API name of the current site.

methods.name: getOriginalUrl
methods.description:
Returns the original URL for this page if it’s a designated error page for the
  site; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: getPasswordPolicyStatement
methods.description:
Returns the password requirements for a Salesforce Site or
      Experience Cloud site created with the Customer Service template.

methods.name: getPathPrefix
methods.description:
Returns the URL path prefix of the current site or an empty string if none. For example,
    if the requested site URL is https://myco.my.salesforce-sites.com/partners,
    then /partners is the path prefix. If the current request is not a site
    request, then this method returns an empty string. This method replaced getPrefix in API version
    30.0.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Deprecated. This method was replaced by getPathPrefix() in API version 30.0.

methods.name: getSiteId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the current site. If the current request is not a site request, then
  this field returns null.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description:
Returns the template name associated with the current site; returns the default template
  if no template has been designated.

methods.name: getSiteType
methods.description:
Returns the API value of the site type field for the current site. This can be
    Visualforce for a Salesforce site, Siteforce for a Site.com site, ChatterNetwork for an
    Experience Cloud site, or ChatterNetworkPicasso for an Experience Cloud site. If the current
    request is not a site request, then this method returns null.

methods.name: getSiteTypeLabel
methods.description:
Returns the value of the Site Type field's label for the current site. If the current
  request is not a site request, then this method returns null.

methods.name: isLoginEnabled
methods.description:
Returns true if the current site is associated with
  an active login-enabled portal; otherwise returns false.

methods.name: isPasswordExpired
methods.description:
For authenticated users, returns true if the
  currently logged-in user's password is expired. For non-authenticated users, returns false.

methods.name: isRegistrationEnabled
methods.description:
Returns true if the current site is associated with
  an active self-registration-enabled Customer Portal; otherwise returns false.

methods.name: isValidUsername
methods.description:
Returns true if the given
      username is valid; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: login
methods.signature:
public static System.PageReference login(String
username, String password, String startUrl)
methods.description:
Allows users to log in to the current site with the given
username and password, then takes them to the startUrl. If startUrl is not a relative path,
it defaults to the site's designated index page.

methods.name: passwordlessLogin
methods.signature:
public static System.PageReference passwordlessLogin(Id
          userId, List<Auth.VerificationMethod> methods, String startUrl)
methods.description:
Logs in a user to a Salesforce Site or Experience Cloud site using
      an identity verification method, such as email or text, instead of a password. Passwordless
      login is a convenient, mobile-centric way to welcome users into your site. Let your users log
      in with something other than their password, like their email address or phone
    number.

methods.name: setExperienceId
methods.description:
Sets the experience ID for the current user. Use this method to
      populate the value of the experience ID (expid) cookie in the user’s web
    browser.

methods.name: setPortalUserAsAuthProvider
methods.signature:
public static Void setPortalUserAsAuthProvider(sObject user,
     String contactId)
methods.description:
Sets the specified user information within the site’s portal via an
  authentication provider.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.signature:
public static void validatePassword(SObject user, String
          password, String confirmPassword)
methods.description:
Indicates whether a given password meets the requirements specified
      by org-wide or profile-based password policies in the current user’s org.

name: SObject
description: Contains methods for the sObject data type.

Marks a trigger record with a custom error message and prevents any DML operation from

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the SObject record.

methods.description: Creates a copy of the SObject record.

methods.name: get
methods.description:
Returns the value for the field specified by the field token Schema.sObjectField, such as,
            Schema.Account.AccountNumber.

methods.name: getCloneSourceId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the entity from which an object was cloned. You can use it for
        objects cloned through the Salesforce user interface. You can also use it for objects
        created using the System.SObject.clone(preserveId, isDeepClone, preserveReadonlyTimestamps,
                preserveAutonumber) method, provided that the
            preserveId parameter wasn’t used or was set to false. The getCloneSourceId() method can only be used within the transaction where the
        entity is cloned, as clone information doesn’t persist in subsequent
        transactions.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description:
Returns a list of Database.Error objects for an SObject instance. If the SObject has no errors, an
      empty list is returned.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the database.DMLOptions object for the SObject.

methods.name: getPopulatedFieldsAsMap
methods.description:
Returns a map of populated field names and their corresponding values.
            The map contains only the fields that have been populated in memory for the SObject
            instance.

methods.name: getSObject
methods.description:
Returns the value for the specified field. This method
is primarily used with dynamic DML to access values for external IDs.

methods.name: getSObject
methods.description:
Returns the value for the field specified by the field token Schema.sObjectField,
                such as, Schema.MyObj.MyExternalId. This
                method is primarily used with dynamic DML to access values for external
                IDs.

methods.name: getSObjects
methods.description:
Returns the values for the specified field. This method
is primarily used with dynamic DML to access values  for associated
objects, such as child relationships.

methods.name: getSObjects
methods.description:
Returns the value for the field specified by the field
token Schema.fieldName, such as, Schema.Account.Contact. This method is primarily used with dynamic DML to access values
 for associated objects, such as child relationships.

methods.name: getSObjectType
methods.description:
Returns the token for this SObject. This method is primarily
      used with describe information.

methods.name: getQuickActionName
methods.description:
Retrieves the name of a quick action associated with
            this SObject. Typically used in triggers.

methods.name: hasErrors
methods.description:
Returns true if an SObject instance has associated errors. The error
      message can be associated to the SObject instance by using SObject.addError(), validation rules, or by other means.

methods.name: isClone
methods.description:
Returns true if an entity is
            cloned from something, even if the entity hasn’t been saved. The method can only be used
            within the transaction where the entity is cloned, as clone information doesn’t persist
            in subsequent transactions.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description:
Returns information about the queried sObject field. Returns true if the sObject field is populated, either by direct
      assignment or by inclusion in a SOQL query. Returns false if the sObject field isn’t set. If an invalid field is specified, an
      SObjectException is thrown.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description:
Returns information about the queried sObject field. Returns true if the sObject field is populated, either by direct
      assignment or by inclusion in a SOQL query. Returns false if the sObject field isn’t set. If an invalid field is specified, an
      SObjectException is thrown.

value)

Sets the value for the specified field and returns the
previous value for the field.

          value)

Sets the value for the field specified by the field token Schema.sObjectField, such as, Schema.Account.AccountNumber and returns the previous value
    for the field.

methods.name: putSObject

public SObject putSObject(String fieldName, SObject
          value)
methods.description:
Sets the value for the specified field. This method is
primarily used with dynamic DML for setting external IDs. The method
returns the previous value of the field.

methods.description:
Sets the value for the field specified by the token Schema.SObjectType. This method is primarily used with dynamic DML for setting external
  IDs. The method returns the previous value of the field.

name: SObjectAccessDecision
description: Contains the results of a call to the Security.stripInaccessible method and methods to retrieve those results.

methods.name: getModifiedIndexes
methods.description: Returns the indexes of sObjects that are modified by the stripInaccessible method.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description:
Returns a list of new sObjects that are identical to the source
      records, except that they are stripped of fields that fail the field-level security check for
      the current user.

methods.name: getRemovedFields
methods.description:
Returns a map of sObject types to their corresponding inaccessible
            fields. The map key is a string representation of the sObject type. The map value is a
            set of strings, which denote the fields names that are inaccessible.

name: SoqlStubProvider

        360 data model objects (DMOs).

Utility class used to specify a fake response for testing
HTTP callouts.

methods.name: setStatusCode

name: String
description: Contains methods for the String primitive data type.

methods.name: abbreviate
methods.description:
Returns an abbreviated version of the String, of the specified
length and with ellipses appended if the current String is longer
than the specified length; otherwise, returns the original String
without ellipses.

methods.name: abbreviate
methods.signature:
public String abbreviate(Integer maxWidth,
Integer offset)
methods.description:
Returns an abbreviated version of the String, starting
at the specified character offset and of the specified length. The
returned String has ellipses appended at the start and the end if
characters have been removed at these locations.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description:
Returns the current String with the first letter changed
to title case.

methods.name: center
methods.description:
Returns a version of the current String of the specified
size padded with spaces on the left and right, so that it appears
in the center. If the specified size is smaller than the current String
size, the entire String is returned without added spaces.

methods.name: center
methods.signature:
public String center(Integer size, String
    paddingString)
methods.description:
Returns a version of the current String of the specified
size padded with the specified String on the left and right, so that
it appears in the center. If the specified size is smaller than the
current String size, the entire String is returned without padding.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description:
Returns the value of the character at
the specified index.

methods.name: codePointAt
methods.description:
Returns the Unicode code point value
at the specified index.

methods.name: codePointBefore
methods.description:
Returns the Unicode code point value
that occurs before the specified index.

methods.name: codePointCount
methods.signature:
public Integer codePointCount(Integer beginIndex,
Integer endIndex)
methods.description:
Returns the number of Unicode code points
within the specified text range.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description:
Compares two strings lexicographically, based on the Unicode
value of each character in the Strings.

methods.name: contains
methods.description:
Returns true if and only if the String that
      called the method contains the specified sequence of characters in
         substring.

methods.name: containsAny
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains any of the characters in the specified
String; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: containsIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains the specified sequence of characters without
regard to case; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: containsNone
methods.description:
Returns true if the current String doesn’t
    contain any of the characters in the specified String; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: containsOnly
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains characters only from the specified sequence
of characters and not any other characters; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: containsWhitespace
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains any white space characters; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: countMatches
methods.description:
Returns the number of times the specified substring occurs
in the current String.

methods.name: deleteWhitespace
methods.description:
Returns a version of the current String with all white
space characters removed.

methods.name: difference
methods.description:
Returns the difference between the current String and the
specified String.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description:
Returns true if
the String that called the method ends with the specified suffix.

methods.name: endsWithIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String ends with the specified suffix; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: equals
methods.description:
Deprecated. This method is replaced by equals(stringOrId). Returns true if the
      passed-in string is not null and represents the same binary sequence of characters as the
      current string. Use this method to perform case-sensitive comparisons.

methods.name: equals
methods.description:
Returns true if the
         passed-in object is not null and represents the same binary sequence of characters as the
         current string. Use this method to compare a string to an object that represents a string
         or an ID.

methods.name: equalsIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Returns true if the
      secondString isn’t null and represents the same sequence of characters as
    the String that called the method, ignoring case.

methods.name: escapeCsv
methods.description:
Returns a String for a CSV column enclosed in double quotes,
if required.

methods.name: escapeEcmaScript
methods.description: Escapes the characters in the String using EcmaScript String rules.

methods.name: escapeHtml3
methods.description: Escapes the characters in a String using HTML 3.0 entities.

methods.name: escapeHtml4
methods.description: Escapes the characters in a String using HTML 4.0 entities.

methods.name: escapeJava
methods.description:
Returns a String whose characters are escaped using Java
String rules. Characters escaped include quotes and control characters,
such as tab, backslash, and carriage return characters.

methods.name: escapeSingleQuotes
methods.description:
Returns a String with the escape character (\)
    added before any single quotation mark (') or backslash
      (\) in the String s.

methods.name: escapeUnicode
methods.description:
Returns a String whose Unicode characters are escaped to
a Unicode escape sequence.

methods.name: escapeXml
methods.description: Escapes the characters in a String using XML entities.

methods.name: format
methods.signature:
public static String format(String stringToFormat,
          List<Object> formattingArguments)
methods.description:
Treat the first argument as a pattern and return a string using the second
      argument for substitution and formatting. The substitution and formatting are the same as
        apex:outputText and the Java MessageFormat class. Non-string types in the second
      argument’s List are implicitly converted to strings, respecting the toString() method
      overrides that exist on the type.

methods.name: fromCharArray
methods.description: Returns a String from the values of the list of integers.

methods.name: getChars
methods.description:
Returns an array of character values
that represent the characters in this string.

methods.name: getCommonPrefix
methods.description:
Returns the initial sequence of characters as a String
that is common to all the specified Strings.

methods.name: getLevenshteinDistance
methods.description:
Returns the Levenshtein distance between the current String
and the specified String.

methods.name: getLevenshteinDistance
methods.signature:
public Integer getLevenshteinDistance(String
stringToCompare, Integer threshold)
methods.description:
Returns the Levenshtein distance between the current String
and the specified String if it is less than or equal than the given
threshold; otherwise, returns -1.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code value for this string.

methods.name: indexOf

Returns the index of the first occurrence of the specified
substring. If the substring does not occur, this method returns -1.

methods.description:
Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of
the specified substring from the point of the given index. If the
substring does not occur, this method returns -1.

methods.name: indexOfAny
methods.description:
Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of
any character specified in the substring. If none of the characters
occur, returns -1.

methods.name: indexOfAnyBut
methods.description:
Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of
a character that is not in the specified substring. Otherwise, returns
-1.

methods.name: indexOfChar
methods.description:
Returns the index of the first occurrence
of the character that corresponds to the specified character value.

methods.name: indexOfChar
methods.signature:
public Integer indexOfChar(Integer character,
Integer startIndex)
methods.description:
Returns the index of the first occurrence
of the character that corresponds to the specified character value,
starting from the specified index.

methods.name: indexOfDifference
methods.description:
Returns the zero-based index of the character where the
current String begins to differ from the specified String.

methods.name: indexOfIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of
the specified substring without regard to case. If the substring does
not occur, this method returns -1.

methods.name: indexOfIgnoreCase
methods.signature:
public Integer indexOfIgnoreCase(String substring,
Integer startPosition)
methods.description:
Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of
the specified substring from the point of index i, without regard to case. If the substring does not occur, this method
returns -1.

methods.name: isAllLowerCase
methods.description:
Returns true if
all characters in the current String are lowercase; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isAllUpperCase
methods.description:
Returns true if
all characters in the current String are uppercase; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isAlpha
methods.description:
Returns true if
all characters in the current String are Unicode letters only; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: isAlphaSpace
methods.description:
Returns true if
all characters in the current String are Unicode letters or spaces
only; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description:
Returns true if all characters in the current
      String are Unicode letters or digits only; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isAlphanumericSpace
methods.description:
Returns true if all characters in the current
    String are Unicode letters, digits, or spaces only; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isAsciiPrintable
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains only ASCII printable characters; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description:
Returns true if
the specified String is white space, empty (''), or null; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description:
Returns true if
the specified String is empty ('') or null; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isNotBlank
isNotEmpty
methods.description:
Returns true if
the specified String is not empty ('') and not null; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains only Unicode digits; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isNumericSpace
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String contains only Unicode digits or spaces; otherwise,
returns false.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description:
Returns true if the current String contains only
    white space characters or is empty; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: join
methods.signature:
public static String join(Object iterableObj,

methods.description:
Joins the elements of the specified iterable object, such
as a List, into a single String separated by the specified separator.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.description:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of the specified
substring. If the substring does not occur, this method returns -1.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.signature:
public Integer lastIndexOf(String substring,
Integer endPosition)
methods.description:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of the specified
substring, starting from the character at index 0 and ending at the
specified index.

methods.name: lastIndexOfChar
methods.description:
Returns the index of the last occurrence
of the character that corresponds to the specified character value.

methods.name: lastIndexOfChar
methods.signature:
public Integer lastIndexOfChar(Integer character,
Integer endIndex)
methods.description:
Returns the index of the last occurrence
of the character that corresponds to the specified character value,
starting from the specified index.

methods.name: lastIndexOfIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of the specified
substring regardless of case.

methods.name: lastIndexOfIgnoreCase
methods.signature:
public Integer lastIndexOfIgnoreCase(String
substring, Integer endPosition)
methods.description:
Returns the index of the last occurrence of the specified
substring regardless of case, starting from the character at index
0 and ending at the specified index.

methods.name: left
methods.description:
Returns the leftmost characters of the current String of
the specified length.

methods.name: leftPad
methods.description:
Returns the current String padded with spaces on the left
and of the specified length.

methods.name: leftPad
methods.signature: public String leftPad(Integer length, String padStr)
methods.description: Returns the current String padded with String padStr on the left and of the specified length.

methods.name: length
methods.description:
Returns the number of 16-bit Unicode characters contained
in the String.

methods.name: mid
methods.signature:

length)
methods.description:
Returns a new String that begins with the character at
the specified zero-based startIndex with the number
of characters specified by length.

methods.name: normalizeSpace

Returns the current String with leading, trailing, and
repeating white space characters removed.

methods.name: offsetByCodePoints

Integer codePointOffset)
methods.description:
Returns the index of the Unicode code
point that is offset by the specified number of code points, starting
from the given index.

Removes all occurrences of the specified substring and
returns the String result.

methods.name: removeEnd

end of the String.

methods.name: removeEndIgnoreCase

Removes the specified substring only if it occurs at the
end of the String using a case-insensitive match.

methods.name: removeStart
methods.description:
Removes the specified substring only if it occurs at the
beginning of the String.

methods.name: removeStartIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Removes the specified substring only if it occurs at the
beginning of the String using a case-insensitive match.

Returns the current String repeated the specified number
of times.

of times using the specified separator to separate the repeated Strings.

replacement)

Replaces each substring of a string that matches the literal
target sequence target with the specified literal
replacement sequence replacement.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.signature:

replacement)
