Replaces each substring of a string that matches the regular
expression regExp with the replacement sequence replacement.

methods.name: replaceFirst
methods.signature:
public String replaceFirst(String regExp, String
replacement)
methods.description:
Replaces the first substring of a string that matches the
regular expression regExp with the replacement
sequence replacement.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns a String with all the characters reversed.

methods.name: right
methods.description:
Returns the rightmost characters of the current String
of the specified length.

methods.name: rightPad
methods.description:
Returns the current String padded with spaces on the right
and of the specified length.

methods.name: rightPad
methods.signature: public String rightPad(Integer length, String padStr)
methods.description: Returns the current String padded with String padStr on the right and of the specified length.

methods.name: split
methods.description:
Returns a list that contains each substring of
                                the String that is terminated by either the regular expression
                                regExp or the end of the String.

methods.name: split
methods.signature:
public String[] split(String regExp, Integer
                    limit)
methods.description:
Returns a list that contains each substring of the String that is terminated by
        either the regular expression regExp or the end of the
        String.

methods.name: splitByCharacterType
methods.description:
Splits the current String by character type and returns
a list of contiguous character groups of the same type as complete
tokens.

methods.name: splitByCharacterTypeCamelCase
methods.description:
Splits the current String by character type and returns
a list of contiguous character groups of the same type as complete
tokens, with the following exception: the uppercase character, if
any, immediately preceding a lowercase character token belongs to
the following character token rather than to the preceding.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description:
Returns true if
the String that called the method begins with the specified prefix.

methods.name: startsWithIgnoreCase
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current String begins with the specified prefix regardless of
the prefix case.

methods.name: stripHtmlTags
methods.description: Removes HTML markup and returns plain text.

methods.name: substring
methods.description:
Returns a new String that begins with the character at
the specified zero-based startIndex and extends
to the end of the String.

methods.name: substring
methods.signature:
public String substring(Integer startIndex,
Integer endIndex)
methods.description:
Returns a new String that begins with the character at
the specified zero-based startIndex and extends
to the character at endIndex - 1.

methods.name: substringAfter
methods.description:
Returns the substring that occurs after the first occurrence
of the specified separator.

methods.name: substringAfterLast
methods.description:
Returns the substring that occurs after the last occurrence
of the specified separator.

methods.name: substringBefore
methods.description:
Returns the substring that occurs before the first occurrence
of the specified separator.

methods.name: substringBeforeLast
methods.description:
Returns the substring that occurs before the last occurrence
of the specified separator.

methods.name: substringBetween
methods.description:
Returns the substring that occurs between two instances of the specified
         tag String.

methods.name: substringBetween
methods.signature:
public String substringBetween(String open,
String close)
methods.description:
Returns the substring that occurs between the two specified
Strings.

methods.name: swapCase
methods.description:
Swaps the case of all characters and returns the resulting String by using the default
  (English US) locale.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description:
Converts all of the characters in the String to lowercase using the rules of the default
    (English US) locale.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description:
Converts all of the characters in the String to lowercase
using the rules of the specified locale.

methods.name: toUpperCase
methods.description:
Converts all of the characters in the String to uppercase using the rules of the default
      (English US) locale.

methods.name: toUpperCase
methods.description:
Converts all of the characters in the String to the uppercase
using the rules of the specified locale.

methods.name: template
methods.description:
Substitutes variables in a string for their corresponding values in
      the valueMap parameter, and returns the updated
      string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description:
Returns a copy of the string that no longer contains any
leading or trailing white space characters.

methods.name: uncapitalize
methods.description: Returns the current String with the first letter in lowercase.

methods.name: unescapeCsv
methods.description: Returns a String representing an unescaped CSV column.

methods.name: unescapeEcmaScript
methods.description: Unescapes any EcmaScript literals found in the String.

methods.name: unescapeHtml3
methods.description: Unescapes the characters in a String using HTML 3.0 entities.

methods.name: unescapeHtml4
methods.description: Unescapes the characters in a String using HTML 4.0 entities.

methods.name: unescapeJava
methods.description:
Returns a String whose Java literals are unescaped. Literals
unescaped include escape sequences for quotes (\\") and control characters,
such as tab (\\t), and carriage return (\\n).

methods.name: unescapeUnicode
methods.description: Returns a String whose escaped Unicode characters are unescaped.

methods.name: unescapeXml
methods.description: Unescapes the characters in a String using XML entities.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description:
Returns a String that represents the specified Date in
the standard “yyyy-MM-dd” format.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description:
Returns a String that represents the specified Datetime
in the standard “yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss” format for the
local time zone.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Returns a String that represents the specified Decimal.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Returns a String that represents the specified Double.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Returns a String that represents the specified Integer.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Returns a String that represents the specified Long.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description:
Returns a string representation of the specified object
argument.

methods.name: valueOfGmt
methods.description:
Returns a String that represents the specified Datetime
in the standard “yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss” format for the
GMT time zone.

name: StubProvider
description:
StubProvider is a callback
      interface that you can use as part of the Apex stub API to implement a mocking framework. Use
      this interface with the Test.createStub() method to
      create stubbed Apex objects for testing.

methods.name: handleMethodCall
methods.signature:
public Object handleMethodCall(Object stubbedObject,
                    String stubbedMethodName, System.Type returnType, List<System.Type>
                    listOfParamTypes, List<String> listOfParamNames, List<Object>
                    listOfArgs)
methods.description:
Use this method to define the behavior of each method of a stubbed
            class.

name: System
description:
Contains methods for system operations, such as writing
debug messages and scheduling jobs.

methods.name: abortJob
methods.description:
Stops the specified job. If the job is currently executing, the stopped job is still
  visible in the job queue in the Salesforce user interface. The specified job is stopped, but any
  code that is in progress will continue to execute until it completes.

methods.name: assert
methods.signature:
public static Void assert(Boolean condition, Object
                    msg)
methods.description:
Asserts that the specified condition is true. If it isn’t , a fatal error is returned
        that causes code execution to halt.

methods.name: assertEquals
methods.signature:
public static Void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual,
          Object msg)
methods.description:
Asserts that the first two arguments are the same. If they aren’t, a fatal error is
  returned that causes code execution to halt.

methods.name: assertNotEquals
methods.signature:
public static Void assertNotEquals(Object expected, Object
          actual, Object msg)
methods.description:
Asserts that the first two arguments are different. If they’re the same, a fatal error is
  returned that causes code execution to halt.

methods.name: attachFinalizer
methods.description: Attach a finalizer for a Queueable job.

methods.name: currentPageReference
methods.description:
Returns a reference to the current page. This is used with Visualforce
  pages.

methods.name: currentTimeMillis
methods.description:
Returns the current time in milliseconds, which is expressed
as the difference between the current time and midnight, January 1,
1970 UTC.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Writes the specified message, in string format, to the execution debug log. The DEBUG log level is used.

methods.name: debug
methods.signature:
public static Void debug(LoggingLevel logLevel, Object
     msg)
methods.description:
Writes the specified message, in string format, to the execution debug log with the
  specified log level.

methods.name: enqueueJob
methods.description:
Adds a job to the Apex job queue that corresponds to the specified
   queueable class and returns the job ID.

methods.name: enqueueJob
methods.signature:
public static Id enqueueJob(Object queueable, Integer
                delay)
methods.description:
Adds a job to the Apex job queue that corresponds to the specified queueable class and
        returns the job ID. The job is scheduled with a specified minimum delay (0–10
        minutes). The delay is ignored during Apex testing.

methods.name: enqueueJob
methods.signature: public static Id enqueueJob(Object queueable, Object asyncoptions)
methods.description:
Adds a job to the Apex job queue that corresponds to the specified queueable class and
    returns the job ID. Specify a unique signature for your queueable job, the maximum stack depth
    or the minimum queue delay in the asyncOptions parameter.

methods.name: equals
methods.signature:
public static Boolean equals(Object obj1, Object
    obj2)
methods.description:
Returns true if both
   arguments are equal. Otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: getApplicationReadWriteMode
methods.description:
Returns the read write mode set for an organization during
Salesforce.com upgrades and downtimes.

methods.name: getQuiddityShortCode
methods.description: Returns the short code for the Quiddity value of the current Request object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the specified object.

methods.name: isBatch
methods.description:
Returns true if a batch Apex
   job invoked the executing code, or false if not. In API
   version 35.0 and earlier, also returns true if a
   queueable Apex job invoked the code.

methods.name: isFunctionCallback
methods.description:
Returns true if an asynchronous Salesforce
  Function callback invoked the executing code, or false if
  not. Available in API version 51.0 and later.

methods.name: isFuture
methods.description:
Returns true if
the currently executing code is invoked by code contained in a method
annotated with future; false otherwise.

methods.name: isQueueable
methods.description:
Returns true if a
            queueable Apex job invoked the executing code. Returns false if not, including if a batch Apex job or a future method invoked the
            code.

methods.name: isRunningElasticCompute
methods.description: Reserved for future use.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description:
Returns true if the currently executing code is
  invoked by a scheduled Apex job; false
  otherwise.

methods.name: movePassword
methods.signature:
public static Void movePassword(ID targetUserId, ID
               sourceUserId)
methods.description:
Moves the specified user’s password to a different
      user.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in the GMT time zone.

methods.name: pauseJobById
methods.description: Pause a scheduled Apex job specified by its CronTrigger ID.

methods.name: pauseJobByName
methods.description: Pause a scheduled Apex job specified by its name.

methods.name: process
methods.signature:
public static List<Id> process(List<Id> workItemIds, String
     action, String comments, String nextApprover)
methods.description: Processes the list of work item IDs.

methods.name: purgeOldAsyncJobs
methods.description:
Deletes asynchronous Apex job records for jobs that have finished execution before the
      specified date with a Completed, Aborted, or Failed status, and returns the number of records
      deleted.

methods.name: purgeOldAsyncJobs
methods.signature:
public static Integer purgeOldAsyncJobs(Date dt, Integer
               numOfJobs)
methods.description:
Deletes asynchronous Apex job records for the specified number of jobs that finished
      before the specified date and have a Completed, Aborted, or Failed status. Returns the number
      of records deleted.

methods.name: requestVersion
methods.description:
Returns a two-part version that contains the major and minor
         version numbers of a package. Applies to first-generation managed
      packages.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.signature:
public static System.ResetPasswordResult
                    resetPassword(ID userId, Boolean sendUserEmail)
methods.description: Resets the password for the specified user.

methods.name: resetPasswordWithEmailTemplate
methods.signature:
public static System.ResetPasswordResult
          resetPasswordWithEmailTemplate(Id userId, Boolean sendUserEmail, String
          emailTemplateName)
methods.description:
Resets the user's password and sends an email to the user with their
      new password. You specify the email template that is sent to the specified user. Use this
      method for external users of Experience Cloud sites.

methods.name: resumeJobById
methods.description: Resume a paused scheduled Apex job specified by its CronTrigger ID.

methods.name: resumeJobByName
methods.description: Resumes a paused scheduled Apex job specified by its name.

methods.name: runAs
methods.description:
Changes the current package version to the package version
   specified in the argument.

methods.name: runAs
methods.description: Changes the current user to the specified user.

methods.name: schedule
methods.signature:
public static String schedule(String
                                        jobName, String cronExpression, Object
                                        schedulableClass)
methods.description:
Use schedule with an Apex class that
                implements the Schedulable interface to
                schedule the class to run at the time specified by a Cron expression.

methods.name: scheduleBatch
methods.signature:
public static String scheduleBatch(Database.Batchable
batchable, String jobName, Integer minutesFromNow)
methods.description:
Schedules a batch job to run once in the future after the
specified time interval and with the specified job name.

methods.name: scheduleBatch
methods.signature:
public static String scheduleBatch(Database.Batchable
batchable, String jobName, Integer minutesFromNow, Integer scopeSize)
methods.description:
Schedules a batch job to run once in the future after the
specified the time interval, with the specified job name and scope
size. Returns the scheduled job ID (CronTrigger ID).

methods.name: setPassword
methods.signature:
public static Void setPassword(ID userId, String
               password)
methods.description: Sets the password for the specified user.

methods.name: submit
methods.signature:
public static List<ID> submit(List<ID> workItemIds,
          String comments, String nextApprover)
methods.description:
Submits the processed approvals. The current user is the submitter and the entry
    criteria is evaluated for all processes applicable to the current user.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date in the current user's time zone.

name: Test
description: Contains methods related to Apex tests.

methods.name: calculatePermissionSetGroup
methods.description:
Calculates aggregate permissions in specified permission set groups
      for testing.

methods.name: calculatePermissionSetGroup
methods.description:
Calculates aggregate permissions in a specified permission set group
      for testing.

methods.name: clearApexPageMessages
methods.description:
Clear the messages on a Visualforce page while executing Apex test
      methods.

methods.name: createSoqlStub
methods.signature: public static void createSoqlStub(Schema.SObjectType targetType, System.SoqlStubProvider soqlStub)
methods.description:
Creates a stub that will respond to SOQL queries against the specified SObject type you
    can use during testing.

methods.name: createStub
methods.signature:
public static Object createStub(System.Type parentType,
          System.StubProvider stubProvider)
methods.description:
Creates a stubbed version of an Apex class that you can use for
      testing. This method is part of the Apex stub API. You can use it with the System.StubProvider interface to create a mocking
      framework.

methods.name: createStubQueryRow
methods.signature:
public static SObject createStubQueryRow(Schema.SObjectType
          targetType, Map<String,Object> fieldMapWithRelationshipKeys)
methods.description:
Creates an instance of a stubbed SObject type that you can use to provide testing results
    in the extended System.SoqlStubProvider class.

methods.name: createStubQueryRows
methods.signature:
public static List<SObject>
          createStubQueryRows(Schema.SObjectType targetType, List<Map<String,Object>>
          fieldMapWithRelationshipKeysForMultipleRows)
methods.description:
Creates instances of stubbed SObject types that you can use to provide testing results in
        the extended System.SoqlStubProvider class.

methods.name: enableChangeDataCapture
methods.description:
Use this method in an Apex test so that change event notifications are
      generated for all supported Change Data Capture entities. Call this method at the beginning of
      your test before performing DML operations and calling Test.getEventBus().deliver();.

methods.name: enqueueBatchJobs
methods.description:
Adds the specified number of jobs with no-operation contents to the
      test-context queue. It first fills the test batch queue, up to the maximum 5 jobs, and then
      places jobs in the test flex queue. It throws a limit exception when the number of jobs in the
      test flex queue exceeds the allowed limit of 100 jobs.

methods.name: getEventBus
methods.description:
Returns an instance of the test event bus broker, which lets you
      operate on platform event or change event messages in an Apex test. For example, you can call
        Test.getEventBus().deliver() to deliver event
      messages.

methods.name: getFlexQueueOrder
methods.description:
Returns an ordered list of job IDs for jobs in the test-context flex
      queue. The job at index 0 is the next job slated to
      run. This method returns only test-context results, even if it’s annotated with @IsTest(SeeAllData=true).

methods.name: getStandardPricebookId
methods.description:
Returns the ID of the standard price
book in the organization.

methods.name: invokeContinuationMethod
methods.signature:
public static Object invokeContinuationMethod(Object
          controller, Continuation request)
methods.description:
Invokes the callback method for the specified controller and
      continuation in a test method.

methods.name: isRunningTest
methods.description:
Returns true if the currently executing code
was called by code contained in a test method, false otherwise. Use this method if
 you need to run different code depending on whether it was being
called  from a test.

methods.name: isSoqlStubDefined
methods.description:
Returns true if a SOQL stub is defined for an SObject
    type; otherwise returns false.

methods.name: loadData
methods.signature:
public static List<sObject> loadData(Schema.SObjectType
sObjectToken, String resourceName)
methods.description:
Inserts test records from the specified static resource
.csv file and for the specified sObject type, and returns a list of
the inserted sObjects.

methods.name: testNotificationActionHandler
methods.description:
Tests a notification action handler implementation by simulating the
      execution of an action for a specific notification.

methods.name: newSendEmailQuickActionDefaults
methods.signature:
public static QuickAction.SendEmailQuickActionDefaults
                    newSendEmailQuickActionDefaults(ID contextId, ID replyToId)
methods.description:
Creates a new QuickAction.SendEmailQuickActionDefaults instance
            for testing a class implementing the QuickAction.QuickActionDefaultsHandler
            interface.

methods.name: setContinuationResponse
methods.signature:
public static void setContinuationResponse(String
          requestLabel, System.HttpResponse mockResponse)
methods.description:
Sets a mock response for a continuation HTTP request in a test
      method.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.signature:
public static void setCreatedDate(Id recordId, Datetime
          createdDatetime)
methods.description:
Sets CreatedDate for a test-context
    sObject.

methods.name: setCurrentPage
methods.description: A Visualforce test method that sets the current PageReference for the controller.

methods.name: setCurrentPageReference
methods.description: A Visualforce test method that sets the current PageReference for the controller.

methods.name: setFixedSearchResults
methods.description:
Defines a list of fixed search results to be returned by
all subsequent SOSL statements in a test method.

methods.name: setMock
methods.signature:
public static Void setMock(Type interfaceType, Object
     instance)
methods.description:
Sets the response mock mode and instructs the Apex runtime to send a mock response
  whenever a callout is made through the HTTP classes or the auto-generated code from
  WSDLs.

methods.name: setReadOnlyApplicationMode
methods.description:
Sets the application mode for an organization to read-only in an Apex test to simulate
    read-only mode during Salesforce upgrades and downtimes. The application mode is reset to the
    default mode at the end of each Apex test run.

methods.name: startTest
methods.description:
Marks the point in your test
code when your test actually begins.  Use this method when you
are testing governor limits.

methods.name: stopTest
methods.description:
Marks the point in your test code
when your test ends. Use this method in conjunction with the startTest method.

methods.name: testInstall
methods.signature:
public static Void testInstall(InstallHandler
          installImplementation, Version version, Boolean isPush)
methods.description:
Tests the implementation of the InstallHandler interface, which is used for specifying
    a post install script in packages. Tests run as the test initiator in the development
    environment.

methods.name: testSandboxPostCopyScript
methods.signature:
public static void
          testSandboxPostCopyScript(System.SandboxPostCopy script, Id organizationId, Id sandboxId,
          String sandboxName)
methods.description:
Tests the implementation of the SandboxPostCopy Interface, which is
            used for specifying a script to run at the completion of a Sandbox copy. Tests run as
            the test initiator in the development environment.

methods.name: testSandboxPostCopyScript
methods.signature:
public static void testSandboxPostCopyScript(System.SandboxPostCopy
                    script, Id organizationId, Id sandboxId, String sandboxName, Boolean
                    RunAsAutoProcUser)
methods.description:
Tests the implementation of the SandboxPostCopy Interface, which is used for
            specifying a script to run at the completion of a Sandbox copy. When RunAsAutoProcUser is true, tests run as Automated Process user in the development
            environment.

methods.name: testUninstall
methods.description:
Tests the implementation of the UninstallHandler interface, which is used for
    specifying an uninstall script in packages. Tests run as the test initiator in the development
    environment.

name: Time
description: Contains methods for the Time primitive data type.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds the specified number of hours to a Time.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds the specified number of milliseconds to a Time.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds the specified number of minutes to a Time.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds the specified number of seconds to a Time.

methods.name: hour
methods.description: Returns the hour component of a Time.

methods.name: millisecond
methods.description: Returns the millisecond component of a Time.

methods.name: minute
methods.description: Returns the minute component of a Time.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.signature:
public static Time newInstance(Integer hour,
Integer minutes, Integer seconds, Integer milliseconds)
methods.description:
Constructs a Time from Integer representations of the specified hour, minutes, seconds,
  and milliseconds. (UTC is assumed.)

methods.name: second
methods.description: Returns the second component of a Time.

name: TimeZone
description:
Represents a time zone. Contains methods for creating a
new time zone and obtaining time zone properties, such as the time
zone ID, offset, and display name.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns this time zone’s display name.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns this time zone’s ID.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description:
Returns the time zone offset, in milliseconds, of the specified
date to the GMT time zone.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description:
Returns the time zone corresponding to the specified time
zone ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this time zone.

name: Trigger
description:
Use the Trigger class to access run-time context
  information in a trigger, such as the type of trigger or the list of sObject records that the
  trigger operates on.

properties.name: new
properties.description:
A list of the new versions of the sObject records. This sObject list is only available
      in insert, update, and undelete triggers, and the records can only be modified in the
      before triggers.

properties.name: old
properties.description:
A list of the old versions of the sObject records. This sObject list is only available
      in update and delete triggers.

properties.name: newMap
properties.description:
A map of IDs to the new versions of the sObject records. This map is only available in
      before update, after insert, and after update triggers.

properties.name: oldMap
properties.description:
A map of IDs to the old versions of the sObject records. This map is only available in
      update and delete triggers.

properties.name: isExecuting
properties.description:
Returns true if the current context for the Apex code is a trigger, not a Visualforce
      page, a Web service, or an executeanonymous() API call.

properties.name: isInsert
properties.description:
Returns true if this trigger was fired due to an insert operation, from the Salesforce
      user interface, Apex, or the API.

properties.name: isUpdate
properties.description:
Returns true if this trigger was fired due to an update operation, from the Salesforce
      user interface, Apex, or the API.

properties.name: isDelete
properties.description:
Returns true if this trigger was fired due to a delete operation, from the Salesforce
      user interface, Apex, or the API.

properties.name: isBefore
properties.description: Returns true if this trigger was fired before a record was saved.

properties.name: isAfter
properties.description: Returns true if this trigger was fired after a record was saved.

properties.name: isUndelete
properties.description:
Returns true if this trigger was fired after a record was recovered from the Recycle
      Bin.

properties.name: operationType
properties.description:
Returns an enum that corresponds to the current operation, as per the following
      lists.

properties.name: size
properties.description:
The total number of records in a trigger invocation, both for single save operations
      and bulk DML operations.

name: TriggerOperation
description:
System.TriggerOperation enum values are associated with trigger
      events.

        instantiating new types.

Returns true if
the specified type is equal to the current type; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: forName

Returns the type that corresponds to the specified fully qualified class
  name.

methods.signature:

Returns the type that corresponds to the specified namespace and class
      name.

methods.name: getName

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code value for the current type.

methods.name: isAssignableFrom
methods.description:
Returns true if an object reference of the
      specified type can be assigned from the child type; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the current type and returns this new instance.

methods.name: toString
methods.description:
Returns a string representation of the current type, which
is the type name.

name: UninstallHandler
description: Enables custom code to run after a managed package is uninstalled.

methods.name: onUninstall
methods.description: Specifies the actions to be performed on uninstall.

name: URL
description:
Represents a uniform resource locator (URL) and provides access to parts of the URL.
        Enables access to the base URL used to access your Salesforce org.

methods.name: Url
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the URL class using the specified string representation of the
URL.

methods.name: Url
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the URL class by parsing the specified spec within the specified
context.

public Url(String protocol, String host, String
file)
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the URL class using the specified protocol, host, and  file
on the host. The default port for the specified protocol is used.

methods.name: Url
methods.signature:
public Url(String protocol, String host, Integer
port, String file)
methods.description:
Creates a new instance of the URL class using the specified protocol, host, port, and
file on the host.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority portion of the current URL.

methods.name: getCurrentRequestUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of an entire request on a Salesforce instance.

methods.name: getDefaultPort
methods.description:
Returns the default port number of the protocol associated
 with the current URL.

user.

    user.

email address.

Returns true if the context user has a license to the managed package via a package
      license only. Otherwise, returns false.

Returns true if the context user has a license to any managed package denoted by
            the namespace. Otherwise, returns false.

methods.description:
Returns true if the context user has a license to the managed package denoted by the
      package ID. Otherwise, returns false. If the context
      user has access, it’s determined either via the package license or a namespace permission set
      license for the package namespace.

methods.name: isMultiCurrencyOrganization
methods.description: Specifies whether the organization uses multiple currencies.

name: UserManagement
description:
Contains methods to manage end users, for example, to register
            their verification methods, verify their identity, or remove their personal
            information.

methods.name: clone
methods.description:
Makes a duplicate copy of the System.UserManagement
    object.

methods.name: deregisterVerificationMethod
methods.signature:
public static void deregisterVerificationMethod(Id userId,
          Auth.VerificationMethod method)
methods.description:
Deregisters an identity verification method. Use this method to let
      users delete an existing verification method.

methods.name: formatPhoneNumber
methods.signature:
global static String formatPhoneNumber(String countryCode,
          String phoneNumber)
methods.description:
Formats a mobile phone number for a user. Call this method to ensure
      that the phone number is formatted properly before updating a user’s mobile phone
    number.

methods.name: initPasswordlessLogin
methods.signature:
public static String initPasswordlessLogin(Id userId,
          Auth.VerificationMethod method)
methods.description:
Invokes a verification challenge for passwordless login when
      creating custom (Visualforce) Login and Verify pages for customers and
    partners.

methods.name: initRegisterVerificationMethod
methods.description:
Invokes a verification challenge for registering identity
      verification methods with a custom (Visualforce) page. Users can register either their email
      address or phone number.

methods.name: initSelfRegistration
methods.signature:
public static String
          initSelfRegistration(Auth.VerificationMethod method, User user)
methods.description:
Invokes a verification challenge for self-registration when creating
      a custom (Visualforce) Verify page for Experience Cloud self-registration.

methods.name: initVerificationMethod
methods.description:
Initiates a verification service for email, phone (SMS), and the
      Salesforce Authenticator verification methods.

methods.name: initVerificationMethod
methods.signature:
public static String
          initVerificationMethod(Auth.VerificationMethod method, String actionName,
          Map<String,String> extras)
methods.description:
Initiates a verification service for email, phone (SMS), and the
      Salesforce Authenticator verification methods.

methods.name: obfuscateUser
methods.signature:
public static void obfuscateUser(Id userId, String
          username)
methods.description:
Scrambles users’ data on their request when they no longer want
      their personal data recognized in Salesforce. When you invoke the method for the user, the
      data becomes anonymous, and you can never recover it. Use this method to set the username to a
      specific value after it’s scrambled.

methods.name: obfuscateUser
methods.description:
Scrambles users’ data on their request when they no longer want
      their personal data recognized in Salesforce. When you invoke the method for the user, the
      data becomes anonymous, and you can never recover it.

methods.name: registerVerificationMethod
methods.signature:
public static System.PageReference
                    registerVerificationMethod(Auth.VerificationMethod method, String
                    startUrl)
methods.description:
Registers an identity verification method. Verification methods
            can be a time-based one-time password (TOTP), email or text verification code,
            Salesforce Authenticator, or U2F-compatible security key. End users register
            verification methods for themselves.

methods.name: sendAsyncEmailConfirmation
methods.signature:
public static Boolean sendAsyncEmailConfirmation(String
          userId, String emailTemplateId, String networkId, String startUrl)
methods.description:
Send an email message to a user’s email address for verification.
      The message contains a verification link (URL) that the user clicks to verify the email
      address later on. You can send email verifications in bulk.

methods.name: verifyPasswordlessLogin
methods.signature:
public static Auth.VerificationResult
          verifyPasswordlessLogin(Id userId, Auth.VerificationMethod method, String identifier,
          String code, String startUrl)
methods.description:
Completes a verification challenge during a passwordless login that
      uses a custom Verify page (Visualforce only). If the user who is trying to log in enters the
      verification code successfully, the user is logged in.

methods.name: verifyRegisterVerificationMethod
methods.signature:
public static String verifyRegisterVerificationMethod(String
          code, Auth.VerificationMethod method)
methods.description:
Completes registering a user’s email address or phone number as a
      verification method when customizing the identity verification process.

methods.name: verifySelfRegistration
methods.signature:
public static Auth.VerificationResult
          verifySelfRegistration(Auth.VerificationMethod method, String identifier, String code,
          String startUrl)
methods.description:
Completes a verification challenge when creating a custom
      (Visualforce) Verify page for Experience Cloud site self-registration. If the person who is
      attempting to register enters the verification code successfully, the user is created and
      logged in.

methods.name: verifyVerificationMethod
methods.signature:
public static VerificationResult verifyVerificationMethod(String
          identifier, String code, Auth.VerificationMethod method)
methods.description:
Completes the verification service for email, phone (SMS), Salesforce
      Authenticator, password, or time-based one-time password (TOTP) verification
    methods.

name: UUID

Contains methods to randomly generate a version 4 universally unique identifier (UUID),
    compare UUIDs, and convert UUID instance to a string.

methods.name: randomUUID

name: Version

Use the Version methods to get the version of a first-generation managed package (1GP) or
        a migrated second-generation managed package (2GP), and to compare package
        versions.

Creates a new instance of the Version class as a two-part package version using the specified
major and minor version numbers.

Creates a new instance of the Version class as a three-part package version using the
specified major, minor, and patch version numbers.

Returns the major package version of the of the calling
code.

methods.name: minor
methods.description: Returns the minor package version of the calling code.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Returns the patch package version of the calling code or null if there is no patch version.

Invokes an external SOAP web service operation based on an Apex class that is

Web service callouts of a class auto-generated from a WSDL.

The implementation of this method is called by the Apex runtime to send a fake

name: XmlStreamReader
description:
The XmlStreamReader class provides methods for
    forward, read-only access to XML data. You can pull data from XML or skip unwanted events. You
    can parse nested XML content that’s up to 50 nodes deep.

methods.name: XmlStreamReader
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the XmlStreamReader class for the specified XML input.

methods.name: getAttributeCount
methods.description:
Returns the number of attributes on the start element,
excluding namespace definitions.

methods.name: getAttributeLocalName
methods.description:
Returns the local name of the attribute at the specified
index.

methods.name: getAttributeNamespace
methods.description:
Returns the namespace URI of the attribute at the specified
index.

methods.name: getAttributePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of this attribute at the specified index.

methods.name: getAttributeType
methods.description:
Returns the XML type of the attribute at the specified
index.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.signature:
public String getAttributeValue(String namespaceUri, String
     localName)
methods.description: Returns the value of the attribute in the specified localName at the specified URI.

methods.name: getAttributeValueAt
methods.description: Returns the value of the attribute at the specified index.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of XML event the cursor is pointing to.

methods.name: getLocalName
methods.description: Returns the local name of the current event.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Return the current location of the cursor.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description:
If the current event is a start element or end element,
this method returns the URI of the prefix or the default namespace.

methods.name: getNamespaceCount
methods.description:
Returns the number of namespaces declared on a start element
or end element.

methods.name: getNamespacePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix for the namespace declared at the index.

methods.name: getNamespaceURI
methods.description: Return the URI for the given prefix.

methods.name: getNamespaceURIAt
methods.description: Returns the URI for the namespace declared at the index.

methods.name: getPIData
methods.description: Returns the data section of a processing instruction.

methods.name: getPITarget
methods.description: Returns the target section of a processing instruction.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description:
Returns the prefix of the current XML event or null if the event does not have a
prefix.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the current value of the XML event as a string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description:
Returns the XML version specified on the XML declaration.
Returns null if none was declared.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current XML event has a name. Returns false otherwise.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description:
Returns true if
there are more  XML events and false if there are no more XML events.

methods.name: hasText
methods.description:
Returns true if
the current event has text, false otherwise.

methods.name: isCharacters
methods.description:
Returns true if
the cursor points to a character data XML event. Otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: isEndElement
methods.description:
Returns true if
the cursor points to an end tag. Otherwise, it returns false.

methods.name: isStartElement
methods.description:
Returns true if
the cursor points to a start tag. Otherwise, it returns false.

methods.name: isWhiteSpace
methods.description:
Returns true if
the cursor points to a character data XML event that consists of all
white space. Otherwise it returns false.

methods.name: next
methods.description:
Reads the next XML event. A processor may return all contiguous
character data in a single chunk, or it may split it into several
chunks. Returns an integer which indicates the type of event.

methods.name: nextTag
methods.description:
Skips any white space (the isWhiteSpace method returns true), comment, or processing instruction XML events, until
a start element or end element is reached. Returns the index for that
XML event.

methods.name: setCoalescing
methods.description:
If you specify true for returnAsSingleBlock, text is returned in
a single block, from a start element to the first end element or the
next start element, whichever comes first. If you specify it as false, the parser may return text
in multiple blocks.

methods.name: setNamespaceAware
methods.description:
If you specify true for isNamespaceAware, the parser recognizes namespace.
If you specify it as false, the parser does not. The default value is true.

methods.name: toString
methods.description:
Returns a string containing the length of the input XML
given to XmlStreamReader and
the first 50 characters of the input XML.

name: XmlStreamWriter
description:
The XmlStreamWriter class provides methods
        for writing XML data.

methods.name: XmlStreamWriter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the XmlStreamWriter class.

methods.name: close
methods.description:
Closes this instance of an XmlStreamWriter and free any
resources associated with it.

methods.name: getXmlString
methods.description: Returns the XML written by the XmlStreamWriter instance.

methods.name: setDefaultNamespace
methods.description:
Binds the specified URI to the default namespace. This
URI is bound in the scope of the current START_ELEMENT – END_ELEMENT
pair.

Closes any start tags and writes corresponding end tags
to the output stream.

Writes an end tag to the output stream, relying on the
internal state of the writer to determine the prefix and local name.

Writes the XML Declaration using the specified XML encoding
and version.

methods.name: writeStartElement

     String namespaceUri)
methods.description: Writes the start tag specified by localName to the output stream.

name: TerritoryMgmt Namespace
description:
The TerritoryMgmt namespace provides an
  interface used for territory management.

name: OpportunityTerritory2AssignmentFilter Global
description:
Apex interface that allows an implementing class to assign a single
      territory to an opportunity.

methods.name: getOpportunityTerritory2Assignments
methods.description:
Returns the mapping of opportunities to territory IDs. When Salesforce
      invokes this method, it supplies the list of opportunity IDs, except for opportunities that
      have been excluded from territory assignment
    (IsExcludedFromTerritory2Filter=false).

name: TxnSecurity Namespace
description:
The TxnSecurity namespace provides an interface
  used for transaction security.

name: Event
description:
Contains event information that the evaluate
    method uses to evaluate a transaction security policy.

methods.name: Event
methods.description:
Creates an instance of the TxnSecurity.Event
  class.

properties.name: action
properties.description:
Specifies the action being taken on the resource for an Entity event.
      For example, a Login IP resource for an Entity event could have an action of create. The
        action attribute is not used by any other event
      type.

properties.name: data
properties.description:
Contains data used by actions. For example, data for a login event includes the login history ID.
      Returns a map whose keys are the type of event data, like SourceIp.

properties.name: entityId
properties.description:
The ID of any entity associated with the event. For example, the
        entityId of a DataExport event for an Account object
      contains the Account ID.

properties.name: entityName
properties.description: The name of the object the event acts on.

properties.name: organizationId
properties.description:
The ID of the Salesforce org where the event
      occurred.

properties.name: resourceType
properties.description:
The type of resource for the event. For example, an AccessResource
      event could have a Connected Application as a resource type. Not all event types have
      resources.

properties.name: timeStamp
properties.description: The time the event occurred.

properties.name: userId
properties.description: Identifies the user that caused the event.

name: EventCondition
description:
Allows an implementing class to specify whether to take action when
      certain events occur based on a transaction security policy. This interface is only used for
      Apex policies created in Real-Time Event Monitoring.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description:
Evaluates an event against a transaction security policy created in
      Real-Time Event Monitoring. If the event triggers the policy, the method returns
        true.

name: AsyncCondition
description:
Allows an implementing class to make asynchronous Apex calls. This
			interface is used only for transaction security Apex policies created in Real-Time Event
			Monitoring.

name: PolicyCondition
description:
Apex interface that allows an implementing class to specify actions to take when
    certain events occur based on a transaction security policy.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description:
Evaluates an event against a transaction security policy. If the
      event triggers the policy, true is
    returned.

The UserProvisioning namespace provides methods

Enables developers to write Apex test classes for connectors used by

      app.

Writes a specific message, such as an error message, to monitor the

      template collections, individual templates, and template configurations.

      returned template is a map of the template JSON attributes as name/value
    pairs.

      API name. The returned template configuration is a map of the JSON attributes as name/value
      pairs.

      options.
